raw.description:
About us

Our common goal is to strengthen the European landscape, jointly creating unique knowledge for applying trustworthy AI. We believe that AI Agents will be the dominant topic for AI in the near future and that appliedAI with its partner ecosystem will impact how this technology is being used in industry and beyond in Europe.


Your mission

Most of what makes an AI solution survive contact with a large enterprise is not the AI. It is the engineering discipline around it, and that discipline is what you bring. You do not need to arrive as an AI expert - you arrive as someone who knows how professional software gets built, shipped, and kept alive, and you grow into the agentic side alongside a team that is already deep in it. In our Engineering team you set the bar for what production-ready means here.
Your tasks will include:

  • Designing the technical approach for a system slice, from build and test through deployment and operation, including the documentation and artefacts a third party needs to run it without us
  • Shaping how we develop: issue workflows, branching and review standards, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, security checks, and release management
  • Building the classical software around the AI core - services and APIs, data pipelines, infrastructure as code, mostly in Python on Azure 
  • Making solutions operable in enterprise IT landscapes: observability, failure behaviour, security posture, and cost transparency
  • Providing specialist guidance that shapes technical decisions across workstreams, and raising the engineering bar through design and code reviews
  • Making technical trade-offs legible to senior client stakeholders - what a given architecture or operating model costs and enables


Your profile

  • 8+ years building software that went into production and stayed there, ideally shaped by a product organisation with real release discipline
  • Deep working knowledge of the professional software development lifecycle: issue tracking and workflows (e.g. Jira), code review and development standards, CI/CD, automated testing, security scanning, versioning and releases
  • Strong Python, confidence on Azure, and hands-on experience with containers and infrastructure as code
  • Experience handing a system over to a separate operating team, or having operated one yourself long enough to know what that handover really demands
  • Some exposure to GenAI or agentic systems and genuine curiosity to go deeper; deep AI expertise is explicitly not a prerequisite
  • Composure in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, and the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders in English; German is a plus


What we offer

  • A highly qualified and motivated team of ~90 people is on a journey to change the rapidly evolving European AI Landscape
  • Experience the best of both worlds with our hybrid work model: You can choose to work from our vibrant offices - either at the IPAI in Heilbronn or the House of Communication in Munich - while also enjoying the flexibility to work remotely a few days each week
  • Opportunity to shape a variety of projects and the development of new, original content based on the latest developments in AI and its adoption in businesses
  • An atmosphere that encourages to think and experiment in new ways with software, hardware, and processes
  • A highly visible initiative that helps you build a large and high-level network of start-ups, partners, and tech companies
  • A flexible development budget that’s yours to shape - invest it in training, certifications, conferences, or new challenges, however you want to grow
  • Sports membership with Wellpass to access thousands of sports facilities all over Germany (and beyond), as well as online courses
  • JobRad: Lease a bike for a cheaper rate via JobRad and we cover the bike insurance on top
  • Sabbatical option: You can take a sabbatical of up to 3 months after min. 3 years of employment - because sometimes 30 vacation days are not enough to explore the beauty of this world
  • PME Familienservice: A 24/7 support for a successful work & life in any life situation. Benefit from free support in areas like life coaching, child care and many other options
  • Mobility budget: Every month we contribute to your individual mobility usage with public transport or shared mobility offers within the app Moovster
  • Workation: Work from anywhere in the EU/EWR area for up to 3 months per year - combining working at a nice place and spending your leisure time in the evening like vacation

Du übernimmst wichtige Projekte von der Problemdefinition bis zur Umsetzung und zum laufenden Betrieb. Du hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und übersetzt geschäftliche und produktbezogene Anforderungen in wirkungsvolle, pragmatische technische Lösungen. Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Produktteam, der Geschäftsführung sowie internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen. Du unterstützt andere Entwickler und hilfst dabei, unsere technischen Standards und Arbeitsweisen weiterzuentwickeln. Dein Profil Anforderungen: Du kommunizierst ausgezeichnet auf Englisch und kannst komplexe Themen technischen wie nicht-technischen Zielgruppen klar vermitteln. Du zeigst Eigeninitiative, denkst kritisch, setzt klare Prioritäten und treibst Themen eigenverantwortlich bis zum Ergebnis voran. Dabei bist du neugierig und motiviert, dir fehlendes Wissen selbstständig anzueignen. Du verfügst über ein solides Fundament in der Softwareentwicklung und praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb von Produktivsystemen. Du kannst und möchtest überwiegend vor Ort in unserem Münchner Büro arbeiten. Von Vorteil: Du verfügst über professionelle Deutschkenntnisse. Erfahrung in FinTech, Finanzdienstleistungen oder einem anderen regulierten Umfeld. Kenntnisse in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, AWS, Docker, Node.js, React, GraphQL, Serverless- oder ereignisgesteuerten Architekturen. Erfahrung in einem kleinen Team mit breitem individuellem Verantwortungsbereich. Du musst nicht jede genannte Technologie oder Branche kennen. Lernbereitschaft, Verantwortungsübernahme und klare Kommunikation sind uns wichtiger als ein perfekt passender Lebenslauf. Benefits ÖPNV-Ticket: Wir bezuschussen dein Ticket für deine berufliche und private Mobilität. Fitness: Mit einer bezuschussten Urban-Sports-Club-Mitgliedschaft kannst du flexibel in ganz Deutschland trainieren. title: Data Scientist Internship (November, 6 months)
description:
Shift delivers AI agents that transform insurers' most critical work. By combining deep industry expertise and unmatched data resources, Shift provides proven results that have earned the trust of hundreds of the world's leading insurers. Our insurance-grade AI is accurate, explainable, and secure—empowering human experts to move with unmatched speed, total confidence, and a renewed focus on the people they serve.

 

Our culture is built on innovation, trust, and a drive to transform the insurance industry through our SaaS platform. We come from more than 50 different countries and cultures and together we are creating the future of insurance.

Learn more at www.shift-technology.com

 

 

Shift Technology : 

Shift is the leading AI platform for insurance. Shift combines generative, agentic, and predictive AI to transform underwriting, claims, and fraud and risk - driving operational efficiency, exceptional customer experiences and measurable business impact. Trusted by the world's leading insurers, Shift delivers AI when and where it matters most, at scale and with proven results.

The Data Science Team🤖: 

The Data Science team works on a broad range of subjects. We actively participate in the definition and development of our suite of products on fraud detection, anti-money laundering and claim automation. We have a lot of technical and professional experience in data science, data engineering, coding, business understanding, and client interactions. Additionally, we also work on various data types such as structured data, free text, documents, and images.

Your key responsibilities will include🧑‍💻:

  • Setting up and deploying data processing pipelines, such as data reception (batch or real-time), data cleaning, information extraction, and calibration of fraud detection models.
  • Conducting R&D to drive product innovation (machine learning, NLP, image analysis, trend analysis, chatbots, etc.).
  • Partnering in an entire Data Science product lifecycle: understand how sales, legal, product, and engineering are connected together to deliver an AI product to clients.

Your profile and requirements✅: 

  • You are currently enrolled as a master's degree student in either Mathematics,  Statistics, Computer Science, Machine learning and/or Big Data.
  • You must be able to provide an internship agreement (Convention de stage) signed by your school or university for 6 months and you are able to start your internship in NOVEMBER 2026
  • You have experience in object-oriented programming (OOP) such as prior internship, school and/or personal projects so you can write quality production code. Prior experience using C# is a plus.
  • French is mandatory at a fluent level and you can communicate clearly in English.

Why join Shift Technology as a Data Scientist Intern ? 

🤸‍♀️Flexibility, autonomy and adaptability are part of our core values: we are a horizontal organization without bureaucracy (40% of staff are data scientists) but optimal and reduced line management, focus on delivery and development while having a hybrid model.

🧠Learn from inside an AI leader tech company: join the 13th French Unicorn providing hands on training, workshop and sessions with highly experienced AI research Team.  

💶Your commitment, our investment: 2000€ gross monthly gratification, high  conversion rate to full time employee, dedicated HR partner, regular reviews and feedback sessions with your team.

🌍Be part of an international and diverse tech firm: full english speaking environment with 55 different nationalities across the world and 11 offices locations (Paris, Singapore, Tokyo, Sao Paulo, Mexico City, Boston, Madrid, London, Toronto, ...)

🤝Dealing with big clients and developing business skills & knowledge: real life experience with insurance business challenges inside the world of AI.  

What is next ? 🎯

If your application and experience meet our requirements, you can expect :

  • Talent Acquisition interview (30 min)
  • Technical interview 1 (60 min) 
  • Technical interview 2 (60 min) 
  • Hiring manager interview (60 min)

The interview process can take 2 to 3 weeks, depending on the interviewer's availability. Be sure that we are doing our best to get back to you with an answer as fast as possible. If you are not getting an update on your application after 10 days, please reach out to our email address. 

To support our permanent, full time employees at every stage of their careers and lives, we provide a competitive total rewards and benefits package. Here are the global benefits we’d like to highlight:

description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. About the Role Checkout.com is on a mission to transform the shopping experience for millions of consumers. As a senior individual contributor in mobile, you’ll help design and build the products we put in the hands of our end users. Working hand-in-hand with our engineering team and product leaders, you’ll be crafting high-performance, user-friendly experiences, which operate at scale. Your role will extend beyond writing code - you’ll define architecture, lead technical discovery, and help us build the foundations that underpin our consumer offering. What you’ll be doing Architecting and building the mobile experiences that are used directly by millions of consumers around the world. Owning feature development end-to-end, from discovery through to development, and monitoring through to maintenance. Working closely with backend teams to ensure the underlying systems we build are aligned to support our mobile product evolution. description:
Office requirement: Hybrid 3 days a week (Monday/Tuesday/Thursday)

Employment type: Permanent

Seniority level: Mid

As our Account Executive, you’ll:

Be a part of our dynamic global Revenue team reporting to Senior Sales Manager,  UK Mid-Market. You’ll be responsible for helping develop, drive and execute an account plan for generating new business revenue as well as year-on-year expansion and growth for your existing accounts within your remit, in line with GWI’s growth strategy across your book of business.

Working within your dedicated market segment, you will be focused on winning new customers and driving growth & expansion in existing customers in an assigned book of business.  You will be responsible for:

  • Own the development and execution of a GTM strategy for your assigned territory, including existing customers and net-new accounts, to build a pipeline to ensure you can meet and exceed your sales quota.
  • Lead the entire sales cycle with your clients from initial opportunity creation to close.
  • Establish and build credibility with prospects from the outset. You’ll form a unique understanding of business challenges and present needs-based solutions that meet their business objectives
  • Partner closely with your Outbound SDR to craft and execute a winning outbound prospecting strategy that sparks conversations and generates high-quality opportunities
  • Build strong collaborative relationships with CSMs for your assigned customer accounts to ensure you are collectively helping customers drive value using GWI's solutions and identifying further opportunities for expansion.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Marketing, Insights, Leadership and other supporting teams to maximise success in live opportunities.
  • Track and update all sales activity within the CRM and accurately forecast revenue attainment via Salesforce/Clari. 
  • Follow best practices, engaging fully with the available tech stack and continually refine and optimise your approach for maximum impact.

Market Insight 

  • Stay informed about industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies. 
  • Utilise market insights to refine sales strategies, differentiate our offerings, and maintain a competitive edge.

 

What do I need to bring with me?

You’ll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires. Here’s what the team will be looking for in you:

  • Deep experience in SaaS or subscription sales, with a history of navigating and closing complex, enterprise-level deals.
  • A strategic mindset, able to see the bigger picture and connect technology solutions to real business challenges across multiple stakeholders.
  • A consistent track record of achieving (and often exceeding) ambitious goals.
  • First-hand experience bringing innovative, category-defining products to market in highly competitive spaces.
  • The ability to understand client needs and deliver value through both subscription and tailored solutions.
  • Familiarity with a structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC, to guide opportunities through the pipeline with clarity and purpose.
  • Strength in multithreading, building trust, and fostering alignment across diverse buying groups.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce for managing pipeline, forecasting, and driving visibility across the sales process.
  • Clear and confident communication skills, with a talent for making complex ideas simple and compelling.
  • A proactive attitude - someone who thrives on building relationships and opening new opportunities, not just responding to inbound leads.
  • Confidence and credibility in engaging with senior executives and decision-makers.
  • Resilience and adaptability, with experience in the fast-moving world of start-ups and scale-ups.

 

What We Offer 📝

At GWI, you’ll find meaningful work, visible impact, and a culture that empowers you to do your best. Our package includes:

🌱 Time to recharge – 25 days’ annual leave, plus office closures over the holidays.
🌱 Health & wellbeing – Health cash plan, enhanced family benefits, carer days, and mental health support.

🌱 Flexibility & balance – Flexitime, early Friday finishes, hybrid and remote options, plus a “work from home” budget.
🌱 Career growth – Accredited learning, leadership development, and global career mobility.
🌱 Community & impact – DE&I initiatives, volunteering opportunities, donation matching, and payroll giving.

Put all that together and GWI is the friendliest, most fulfilling place any of us has ever worked.

 

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion 🌍

Diversity is fundamental to who we are—both as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to ensure our workforce is as diverse and inclusive as the insights we provide to our clients.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
About us

We love pets - which is why we’re on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents.  We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We’ve helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.  Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.  Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.  Want to join our pack?  Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

A day in the life

As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.

This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.

You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets.

Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.

We embrace modern development practices:

  • All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.
  • We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.
  • We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.

As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.

 

Your responsibilities

ü  Build and maintain secure platform foundations

  • Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.
  • Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.
  • Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.
  • Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.
  • Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.

ü  Make our security controls provable

  • Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements.
  • Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort.
  • Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved.
  • Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.

ü  Strengthen access and identity controls

  • Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.
  • Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.
  • Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.

ü  Extend our platform standards beyond AWS

  • Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.
  • Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.

ü  Team collaboration

  • Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.
  • Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.
  • Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.
  • Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.

ü  Self development

  • Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.
  • Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.
  • Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.

Your skills and experience

We are looking for someone with:

  • Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar.
  • Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.
  • Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.

We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:

  • A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation.
  • Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.

The interview process

This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.

  • Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.
  • Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.
  • Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.
  • Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.

About the team

The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular ‘Hack Weeks’ to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we’re interested in and feel passionately about.

Our tech stack

We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn.  You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.

Our “north star” is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics.  To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean.  We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.

We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices.  We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.

Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare

Salary range:
£55,000—£65,000 GBP

Ways of working

On a typical day you’ll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset.  You’ll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we’d expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day.  We’d ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively.  We’ll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.

Inclusion at ManyPets

We promise to give you the same opportunities as everyone else and we won’t discriminate against you at any point in the process. This includes how we source talent, our interview process, our conditions of employment (including pay) and feedback.  If you'd like to read more about this, please download our Approach to Inclusion policy. 

Reasonable adjustments and support

If you need any help, support, or advice at any point during the hiring process please email

Connect with us!

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer - AI Resilience & Security Enhancements (Fixed-term contract)
description:
THE PROJECT 📝 

We're looking for an experienced Senior Cloud Security Engineer to join Form3 on a 12 month fixed term contract basis to deliver a strategic programme of security enhancements across our cloud-native payments platform. 

Focusing on improving cloud security, operational resilience and governance across our engineering ecosystem, you will work closely with our Platform Engineering and Security teams to design and implement practical security improvements that enhance how we build, deploy and operate critical payment infrastructure. 

You'll play a key role in strengthening areas such as cloud platform security, software supply chain security, identity and access management, AI governance, cryptographic controls and automated security assurance, ensuring solutions are scalable, production-ready and aligned with regulatory expectations. 

Key responsibilities 

  • Assess the current cloud security posture across Form3 environments, identifying risks, control gaps and opportunities for improvement. 
  • Design and implement scalable cloud security controls that improve the resilience and security of our cloud-native platform. 
  • Enhance perimeter security controls across cloud infrastructure. 
  • Strengthen CI/CD pipeline security through secure build processes, automated security testing, deployment governance and artefact integrity. 
  • Improve production access security, including RBAC, least-privilege implementation, deployment tooling and operational processes. 
  • Enhance software supply chain security through dependency management, container image scanning, provenance, signing and vulnerability remediation. 
  • Contribute to the secure adoption and governance of AI-enabled engineering capabilities, including controls for data protection, auditability and operational resilience. 
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on cloud security architecture and secure engineering practices. 
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation, including solution designs, implementation plans, operational procedures and security evidence. 
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, platform and security teams to deliver maintainable, production-ready security improvements. 
  • Ensure all deliverables align with operational resilience requirements, regulatory obligations and internal security standards. 
  • Deliver changes using structured, low-risk change management practices while maintaining service availability. 

 

WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🔍 

Essential 

  • Extensive experience designing and implementing cloud security solutions within large-scale cloud-native environments. 
  • Strong hands-on experience securing public cloud platforms (AWS preferred). 
  • Expertise in cloud security architecture, identity and access management, workload protection and infrastructure security. 
  • Experience securing CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices. 
  • Strong understanding of software supply chain security, including dependency management, artefact signing, provenance and vulnerability management. 
  • Experience implementing least-privilege access models and RBAC. 
  • Knowledge of security monitoring, risk assessment and security governance. 
  • Experience working within highly regulated or business-critical production environments. 
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineering teams. 
  • Strong technical documentation and design skills. 

 

Desirable 

  • Experience implementing security controls for AI or machine learning platforms. 
  • Knowledge of cryptographic controls and key management. 
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and policy-as-code tooling. 
  • Familiarity with payment platforms or financial services environments. 
  • Understanding of operational resilience frameworks and regulatory requirements affecting critical financial infrastructure. 
  • Relevant cloud or security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, CISSP, CCSP or similar). 

 

TECH STACK ⚙️ 

  • AWS – Cloud infrastructure and security controls. 
  • Kubernetes – Container orchestration and workload security. 
  • Terraform – Infrastructure as Code and security automation. 
  • CI/CD tooling – Secure software delivery, build security and deployment governance. 
  • Container security tooling – Image scanning, vulnerability management and runtime protection. 
  • Identity & Access Management (IAM) – Least privilege, RBAC and privileged access controls. 
  • Software Supply Chain Security – Dependency scanning, artefact signing, provenance and integrity controls. 
  • Security monitoring & observability platforms – Detection, auditability and operational visibility. 
  • AI governance and security controls – Supporting secure adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities. 

 

INTERVIEW PROCESS ✍️ 

Stage 1: Screening Call with Talent Team

The Security Incident Response Team (SIRT) is looking for a Security Engineer who is passionate about solving Twilio’s mission of security and reliability by working across the organization to lead the technical response to security events and incidents across Twilio’s global infrastructure, services and applications by effectively conducting triage, containment, remediation and driving post-incident betterments.  You will work within a team that partners with R&D Engineering and R&D Business teams to develop scalable processes and technical solutions.

  • Lead and support the response to all security events and incidents across Twilio’s complex global infrastructure, services and applications.

  • Work cross-collaboratively to understand and help solve challenges related to a broad spectrum of threat actors and activity.
  • Work to improve Twilio’s security and reliability posture by driving identified betterments from security events and incidents.
  • Rapidly acquire new technical skills and knowledge in a fast-paced, highly disruptive industry environment.
  • Own the security incident lifecycle, respond to incidents and participate in on-call rotation and participate in RCAs for security incidents.
  • Build, cultivate, and maintain positive relationships with internal customers to identify and facilitate solutions to increase the impact of the team’s work.
  • Provide mentorship, support, and care for the team in a way that enables long-term career development, happiness, and success at scale.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

  • Subject-matter expert on security issues and technologies
  • Ability to utilize AI for comprehensive, complex security incident response activities delivering high fidelity detections
  • Advanced knowledge of service-oriented architectures, as well as experience with security tools and technologies fit for a cloud environment
  • Experience working across a technology stack on difficult security challenges and initiatives
  • Experience with SIEM platforms and the ability to extend their functionality
  • Experience with SOAR tools and automating manual security processes
  • Experience in either AWS, GCP, or other large cloud platform
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to influence and build effective working relationships with every level of the organization.

Desired:

  • AI Model Security & Posture Management: Support Implementation of  controls and safeguards to prevent AI vulnerabilities, such as prompt injections, model evasion, and data poisoning
  • AI-Driven Threat Response: Utilize GenAI and LLM-based security use cases to rapidly interpret alerts, reduce false positives, and contextualize threat data
  • Artifact & Evidence Triage: Collects intrusion artifacts and forensically sound images to analyze malware, trojans, and source code.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in Ireland or U.K.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

Love every moment. Love ManyPets.

A day in the life

As a Platform Engineer, you will join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.

This role has a security focus. Much of your first year will be spent building the tooling that lets us demonstrate our security controls are working: automated compliance checks, reporting, and evidence collection to support our ISO 27001 commitments. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.

You will also work closely with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security capability at ManyPets.

Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.

We embrace modern development practices:

  • All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.
  • We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.
  • We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.

As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.

 

Your responsibilities

ü  Build and maintain secure platform foundations

  • Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.
  • Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.
  • Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.
  • Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.
  • Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.

ü  Make our security controls provable

  • Build automated checks that continuously test our cloud estate against our security and compliance requirements.
  • Automate the collection and reporting of evidence for ISO 27001, replacing manual effort.
  • Surface and report on gaps, drift and findings so they can be prioritised and resolved.
  • Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.

ü  Strengthen access and identity controls

  • Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.
  • Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.
  • Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.

ü  Extend our platform standards beyond AWS

  • Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.
  • Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.

ü  Team collaboration

  • Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.
  • Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.
  • Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.
  • Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.

ü  Self development

  • Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.
  • Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.
  • Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.

Your skills and experience

We are looking for someone with:

  • Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code, using CDK, Terraform or similar.
  • Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
  • A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including identity and access management, secrets management, network controls and encryption.
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.
  • Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.

We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:

  • A security specialism, such as cloud security posture management, security tooling, threat modelling or compliance automation.
  • Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.

The interview process

This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.

  • Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.
  • Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.
  • Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.
  • Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.

About the team

The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular 'Hack Weeks' to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we're interested in and feel passionately about.

Our tech stack

We are on a mission to become the best we can be, constantly challenging ourselves to achieve and learn.  You will be supported to learn new technology – both in breadth and depth - and encouraged to challenge our ways of thinking with new and innovative ideas.

Our "north star" is to become an elite performer as defined by the 4 key DORA metrics.  To drive towards elite status, we apply and continually inspect and adapt the best Agile frameworks and practices inspired by DevOps, SRE, Scrum, XP and Lean.  We are a highly collaborative environment and regularly practice Mob and Pair based programming which we believe improve our quality of delivery and share understanding.

We take our operational performance, security, and reliability as seriously as our quality and development practices.  We are cloud hosted and highly automated, primarily on AWS with some critical services running on Google Cloud.

Some specific technologies we use include: AWS | Google Cloud | Python | CDK | GitHub Actions | MongoDB | Aikido | Cloudflare

£55,000—£65,000 GBP

Ways of working

On a typical day you'll be working from a laptop with a screen, mouse, keyboard, and headset.  You'll be meeting your colleagues on Zoom and keeping in touch regularly via email and Slack too – we'd expect you to be using your computer for around seven hours a day.  We'd ask that you have a distraction-free work area and a reliable internet connection with a speed of 25Mbps so you can work effectively.  We'll make sure you have the right home set-up that supports you in the role by providing best-in-class technology, money towards a desk, and vision support.

title: Product Engineer (Senior)
description: 📍London/ Hybrid £80,000 - £115,000 + £30,000 share options + Benefits 💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients. For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication. What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices. Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book , which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time. The team Our engineers have sat in GP waiting rooms. They've watched practice managers juggle three systems at once to send a single message to a patient. They build for that person. What sets our Product Engineers apart is that they own the problem, not just the code. They shape what gets built and how - working with Product, Design and Clinical from the earliest stages - and they stay with the systems they build as they evolve. They bring engineering judgment into product decisions, and product thinking into engineering ones. Our stack is primarily C# on the backend, TypeScript and React on the frontend, running on Azure. ML/AI work uses Python. We don't expect you to know all of it - we expect you to follow a problem wherever it leads. 💬 Accurx is where conversations happen with and about patients.

For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. We’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that connects everyone through communication.

What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.

The team

Our engineers have sat in GP waiting rooms. They've watched practice managers juggle three systems at once to send a single message to a patient. They build for that person.

What sets our Product Engineers apart is that they own the problem, not just the code. They shape what gets built and how - working with Product, Design and Clinical from the earliest stages - and they stay with the systems they build as they evolve. They bring engineering judgment into product decisions, and product thinking into engineering ones.

You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to fix healthcare communication.

description:
Push the boundaries of what Coveo can do, one solution at a time

How do you turn ambitious use cases into real, working solutions that prove their value fast? As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you bring ideas to life through hands-on prototyping, transforming complex requirements into tangible, high-impact solutions.

You’ll operate at the edge of what’s possible with Coveo, working directly with customers and internal teams to validate new use cases, push product boundaries, and shape what comes next, before it reaches production.

This role supports our DACH customers, working on European business hours. You’ll own a portfolio of accounts, working in German and English, and travelling to customer sites when the engagement calls for it.

As our Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:

  • Disambiguate customer needs to shape clear, compelling use cases and solution architectures.
  • Build working prototypes and technical proofs based on approved use cases.
  • Translate business and architectural requirements into functional, testable solutions.
  • Validate solution feasibility, performance, and scalability through hands-on experimentation.
  • Iterate rapidly on solutions to accelerate production readiness, generating reusable patterns and sharing insights across teams.
  • Serve as the primary technical owner for assigned DACH accounts, building trusted stakeholder relationships and driving solutions to adoption while working European hours and traveling on-site as required.
  • Deliver workshops, requirements sessions, technical documentation, and demos fluently in German and English.

Here is what will qualify you for the role:

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in software engineering, system integration, or related fields.
  • Professional fluency in both German and English (written and spoken) for customer-facing delivery.
  • Strong technical prototyping skills spanning APIs, data pipelines, and front-end/back-end systems.
  • Proven track record in ambiguous, high-impact environments, combining strong problem-solving skills with a rapid, experimentation-driven mindset.

What will make you stand out:

  • Experience working directly with customers in technical, solution-oriented roles
  • Ability to navigate between business context and deep technical execution
  • Curiosity and drive to explore new approaches and push product capabilities further
  • Experience contributing insights that influence product or platform evolution

 You don’t need to check every single box; passion goes a long way and we appreciate that skillsets are transferable.

title: Senior Business Process Manager (m/w/d)
description:
About The Company

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with various design options, industrial offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company manufactures aspirational, sustainable, and affordable homes using timber construction methods. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, boost Europe's strength in innovation, while also playing a substantial role in improving sustainability.

Über die Position

Als Senior Business Process Manager im Bereich Supply Flow & Central Disposition übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle in der Gestaltung, Harmonisierung und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer End-to-End-Supply-Chain-Prozesse.

Du stellst sicher, dass die Flow- und Supply-Chain-Strategie von GROPYUS in robuste, skalierbare und effiziente Geschäftsprozesse übersetzt wird – von der Produktionsplanung über Transport bis zur Baustellenlogistik.

Dein Fokus liegt auf Prozessdesign, Operational Excellence und datengetriebener Steuerung, mit starkem Bezug zur operativen Umsetzung. 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Gestaltung und kontinuierliche Optimierung der End-to-End Supply-Chain-Prozesse (Werk–Transport–Baustelle) sowie Sicherstellung eines konsistenten Masterplans über alle Projekte  
  • Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von Kapazitäts-, Slotting- und Sequenzierungsprozessen zur Sicherstellung eines stabilen Materialflusses  
  • Früherkennung von Abweichungen und Engpässen sowie Ableitung und Umsetzung geeigneter Maßnahmen  
  • Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung von Lean-, TOC- und digitalen Steuerungsansätzen (z. B. SAP, Track & Trace, Control Tower) inklusive KPI-basiertem Performance-Monitoring  
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit relevanten Fachbereichen zur Sicherstellung von Materialverfügbarkeit, Termintreue und reibungslosen Abläufen  
  • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Optimierungsmaßnahmen sowie Etablierung von Best Practices und einer datengetriebenen Prozesskultur 

Über dich

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Logistik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich 
  • Mehrjährige relevante Erfahrung (ca. 5 – 10 Jahre) im Business Process Management, Supply Chain Management oder in der Produktions- bzw. Projektlogistik 
  • Erfahrung in der Gestaltung und Optimierung von End-to-End-Prozessen in komplexen, dynamischen Umfeldern  
  • Starkes Verständnis für Materialflüsse, Produktionslogistik, Engpassmanagement (TOC) und Transportprozesse  
  • Praxis mit Anwendung von ERP-/APS-Systemen, Track-&-Trace-Lösungen sowie KPI-basierter Steuerung 
  • Analytische, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise gepaart mit hoher Umsetzungsstärke  
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit und die Fähigkeit, Veränderungen bereichsübergreifend voranzutreiben  
  • Begeisterung für Prozessoptimierung, Digitalisierung und industrialisierte Bauprozesse
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse  

Über uns

  • Ein unbefristeter Vertrag mit 30 Urlaubstagen.
  • Flexible Arbeitsweise: Wir legen großen Wert auf regelmäßige persönliche Zusammenarbeit im Büro, und bieten auch die Möglichkeit zum Arbeiten im Homeoffice sowie die Option, bis zu 40 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Wir bieten eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Sprachkurse (Englisch/Deutsch) und Mitarbeiterrabatte bei ausgewählten nachhaltigen Marken. Darüber hinaus unterstützen Dich unsere externen Partner im Bereich mentale Gesundheit, um Deine psychische Gesundheit durch anonyme Einzel- oder Gruppensitzungen zu stärken.
  • Virtuelles Aktienprogramm: Profitiere von GROPYUS Erfolg durch unser Virtuelles Aktienprogramm.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du kannst wirklich etwas bewirken – auf allen Ebenen unserer Organisation. Finde Lösungen, treibe sie voran, teste und implementiere sie.
  • Die Chance, Teil von etwas Großem zu sein: Unsere Mission ist es, eine ganze Branche neu zu denken. Hilf uns dabei, das Bauwesen neu zu erfinden und nachhaltiges, erschwingliches Wohnen zu fördern.
  • Ein vielfältiges und bereicherndes Arbeitsumfeld: Werde ein geschätztes Mitglied eines wunderbar vielfältigen Teams von Menschen aus über 50 Ländern. Bei GROPYUS legen wir großen Wert auf Inklusion und sorgen dafür, dass sich jeder – unabhängig von seinem Hintergrund – als Teil der Gemeinschaft fühlt. So werden unsere Unterschiede zu Stärken, die uns als Team weiterbringen. 

Join us on our mission to design buildings as continuously evolving products to create the most exciting and affordable experience for all. We build for people and conserve the resources of our planet.

We can't wait to get to know you. 
For more information, visit our website.

title: Senior Security Consultant
description:
Who is Tenable?

Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey!

What makes Tenable such a great place to work?

Ask a member of our team and they’ll answer, “Our people!” We work together to build and innovate best-in-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you’re part of our #OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together!

Your Role:

The Security Consultant plays a key role in implementing and enabling Tenable’s Exposure Management solutions to help organizations effectively manage and reduce cyber risks. This role onboards Tenable technologies, following industry standards and best practices, to deliver customized solutions that address vulnerabilities across a client’s attack surface. This role's primary focus will be on client billable work, where you will ensure the efficient identification and mitigation of vulnerabilities. Additionally, the role will have the chance to broaden your knowledge across the Tenable portfolio through hands-on experience and learning opportunities facilitated by the Professional Services Organization.

Organisation Structure:

  • Reports to: Professional Services Delivery Manager/ Director
  • Direct reports: None

Security Consultant Accountabilities:

Client Engagement & Relationship Management:

  • Develop a deep understanding of the client’s business and unique security needs to deliver tailored engagements that exceed expectations.
  • Build and maintain positive relationships with clients, ensuring ongoing satisfaction and partnership.
  • Provide clients with continual insights and consultative advice based on experience with Tenable products, their industry, established standards, and best practices.

Subject Matter Expertise and Solution Implementation & Enablement:

  • Support clients with the installation, configuration, and operation of Tenable solutions, ensuring they are effectively implemented to meet business and security goals.
  • Oversee upgrades and migrations to new hardware or software, facilitating smooth transitions with minimal disruption.
  • Offer expert guidance on implementing best practices with Tenable solutions to optimize security workflows and operational efficiency.
  • Assist clients in developing and maintaining security policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring they align with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide ongoing value through insights and consultative advice on Tenable products, tailored to client needs and industry best practices.
  • Share thought leadership on effective deployment and utilization of Tenable One solutions.
  • Guide clients in implementing best practices and developing Exposure Management Programs.
  • Assess user needs and customer requirements to advance the maturity of their Exposure Management program.

Value Delivery and Best Practices:

  • Deliver additional value through continual insights and consultative advice based on Tenable products, client needs, industry standards, and best practices.
  • Provide thought leadership on methods and best practices for deploying and using Tenable One solutions.
  • Advise clients on process best practices and assist in developing Exposure Management Programs.
  • Research user needs and assess customer requirements to enhance the maturity of their Exposure Management program.

Customer Engagement and Satisfaction:

  • Ensure overall customer satisfaction while supporting delivery revenue objectives.
  • Execute large customer engagements, understanding client business and unique needs to exceed expectations.
  • Independently manage client escalations on assigned projects, coordinating with the delivery team and other Tenable departments as needed.
  • Develop and maintain positive client relationships and train client staff on the implementation, configuration, and best practices of the Tenable suite.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Perform other duties as assigned to support the success of the Professional Services team and the overall organization.

Knowledge, Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in the Information Technology/Cyber Security field and professional services experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related technical field such as Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent work experience.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English + another Language preferably Italian, Dutch or French. Must be comfortable leading 3+ hour calls and keeping up the progression of tasks on the call while assuring that all relevant topics are addressed.
  • Strong analytical skills and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex security issues.

title: Product Manager (m/w/d) – Digital Wealth Management (apeiron)
description: Über Uns Ginmon ist einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Deutschland. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2014 in Frankfurt am Main verfolgt das Unternehmen die Mission, professionelles, wissenschaftlich fundiertes Vermögensmanagement einer breiten Zielgruppe zugänglich zu machen. Mit apeiron hat Ginmon diese Technologie und Investment Expertise zu einer eigenständigen B2B-Plattform weiterentwickelt, die sich gezielt an unabhängige Vermögensberater:innen richtet. apeiron unterstützt Berater:innen mit intelligenten Tools für Beratung, Portfoliomanagement, digitales Onboarding, Gebührenabrechnung und Wertpapierabwicklung und ermöglicht ihnen damit ein modernes, skalierbares Endkundenerlebnis. Als Product Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung von apeiron und gestaltest somit die technologische Zukunft der unabhängigen Vermögensberatung in Deutschland aktiv mit. Deine Aufgaben Du führst Markt- und Nutzerforschung durch und identifizierst neue Produkt-Features und Trends im Bereich WealthTech. Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools wie Claude, Gemini sowie Design-Software wie Figma, um Analysen, Nutzerflows, Produktideen und erste Prototypen schneller zu entwickeln. Du entwickelst die Produkt Roadmap für apeiron und erarbeitest gemeinsam mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams detaillierte Produktanforderungen, User Stories und Abnahmekriterien. Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen im Unternehmen sowie mit externen Partnern und weiteren Interessengruppen zusammen und stimmst dich regelmäßig mit ihnen ab. Du stehst im laufenden Austausch mit unabhängigen Vermögensberater:innen, holst kontinuierlich Feedback ein und übersetzt deren Anforderungen in konkrete Produktverbesserungen. Du stellst sicher, dass Produktfunktionen spezifikationsgerecht, in hoher Qualität und termingerecht umgesetzt werden. Du beobachtest die Leistung bestehender Funktionen und der zugrunde liegenden Plattform und identifizierst Potenziale für technische Optimierungen und UX-Verbesserungen. Du übernimmst vollständige Verantwortung für deine eigenen Themenbereiche und trägst aktiv zu Produktentscheidungen bei. Dein Profil Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium. Du bringst mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder Software-Engineering mit, idealerweise im Fintech- oder Start-up-Umfeld. Du bringst Kenntnisse oder Erfahrung im deutschen Vermögensverwaltungssystem mit, idealerweise im Umfeld unabhängiger Finanzberater:innen oder Vermögensverwalter. Du kennst dich sehr gut mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum sowie dem gesamten Software-Entwicklungszyklus aus. Du hast einen sicheren Umgang mit Tools wie Jira, Claude for Design, Framer, Grafana, Brevo oder Figma. Du arbeitest sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team und triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen. Du kommunizierst sicher und transparent innerhalb deines Teams, unternehmensweit (auch mit CTO und CEO) sowie mit externen Stakeholdern und Berater:innen. Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (mindestens C1), da der laufende Austausch mit deutschen Vermögensberater:innen ein zentraler Teil deiner Rolle ist, sowie fließend Englisch. Du lebst im Rhein-Main-Gebiet und kannst mindestens 60 % deiner Arbeitszeit in unserem Büro in Frankfurt am Main verbringen. Warum Ginmon? Hohes Maß an Autonomie und die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktstrategie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Management-Team aktiv mitzugestalten. Ein dynamisches, internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien, schnellen Entscheidungswegen und einer "Get-things-done"-Mentalität. Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit einem attraktiven, erfolgsorientierten Bonussystem, gekoppelt an deine Partnership-Meilensteine. Beteiligung am langfristigen Erfolg von Ginmon durch ein Virtual Employee Share Option Program (VESOP). Spezielle Konditionen für Mitarbeiterinvestments und Nutzung unserer Plattform; Hybrides Arbeiten (60 % vor Ort) und flexible Arbeitszeiten. Modernes Büro im Herzen Frankfurts mit High-End-Equipment und optimaler ÖPNV-Anbindung. Regelmäßige Teamevents und eine angenehme Büroatmosphäre (Snacks, Getränke, Firmen-Merch u. v. m.). Erstattung deiner Internetkosten und der Kosten für dein Deutschlandticket. Vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Working Student – Technical Onboarding (f/m/d) | B2B SaaS | Berlin (hybrid)
description: We are digitalising one of Europe’s largest and most heavily regulated industries. The packaging industry has a market volume of several hundred billion euros and is under enormous pressure to act due to new regulations such as PPWR, EPR and EUDR. With Packa , we have built the first end-to-end SaaS platform for intelligent packaging management – in high demand, well-funded and growing fast. What you can expect at Packa Ownership: You take on real responsibilities from day one and work closely with an experienced, highly motivated founding team. Learning curve: You learn SaaS onboarding, data integration and customer communication hands-on — with a real area of responsibility, not just busywork. Hybrid working: You will work in a great office in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg. Flexibility: Flexible hours around your studies — 15–20 h/week, starting as soon as possible. Appreciation: We believe in fair compensation and you will benefit from a clear path for growth and development. Impact: Your work directly helps new enterprise customers go live on Packa. Your tasks You support the technical onboarding of new customers: preparing, mapping and verifying data from ERP systems, CSV/Excel files and SFTP. You help run gap analyses of customer data structures and ensure a clean, complete migration into Packa. You handle support during the onboarding phase: responding to emails, triaging tickets, and looping in Engineering or our packaging specialists where needed. You support tenant/user configuration and the preparation of onboarding workshops and training sessions. You contribute to our "Packademy": building out training content, formats and self-serve resources. You feed back what you see during onboarding to Product, helping shape what gets built next. What you bring You are studying Business Informatics, Computer Science, Data Science or a similar field with clear IT affinity. You're confident working with data in CSV/Excel and keen to understand how systems connect — first exposure to SFTP, ERP or APIs is a plus, not a must. You can make sense of a dataset, notice when something doesn't add up, and sort it out on your own. You communicate clearly and directly internally and externally — e.g. with a packaging buyer, a customer's IT manager, or a Packa software engineer. No packaging knowledge required — you'll learn that with us. You're comfortable building as you go: processes here are evolving, and you'd rather improve them than wait for them to be perfect. Fluent in German and good English. You are based in Berlin (or nearby). Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Hybrid working: You will work in a great office in Berlin - Prenzlauer Berg. Impact: You will shape the processes that companies use to make packaging more sustainable and reduce their carbon footprint. Your tasks Champion users and outcomes: Keep a user-first perspective in every decision and make complex packaging and compliance workflows intuitive, clear, and measurable. Conduct user research and discovery: Lead interviews, usability tests, and workshops to understand customer workflows, pain points, and recurring UX friction. Shape workflows and interaction models: Partner with Product and Engineering from early problem framing through solution design, turning complex requirements into coherent end-to-end experiences. title: Head of Supply Chain (f/m/d) - Berlin
description: About us At CYCLE, we're redefining urban mobility for the people who keep cities moving: couriers, riders, and delivery pros. Our e-bike subscription service combines durable vehicles, fast repairs, and real support, everything riders need to stay on the road. From Berlin to London, Vienna to Amsterdam, we operate in 200+ cities across Europe, providing thousands of riders with bikes built for work, not for show. Our mission is simple: make last-mile delivery more reliable, affordable, and sustainable, one ride at a time. With every bike we deploy, we're helping build the backbone of smarter, greener cities. Ride with us into the future - sustainable, efficient, and full speed ahead! Your Mission As Head of Supply Chain , you own every part of how physical goods reach our fleet and our riders, from the purchase order to the shelf to the courier's bike. You report to our Director of Operations and work directly with Hardware, Finance, Software and our country teams. In particular you will: Own supply chain end to end: Purchasing, warehousing, stock keeping and outbound logistics across our European network, as one function with one owner. You ultimately ensure we have the right number of bikes, batteries and parts at the right time, the right place and the best price. Oversee our assembly & refurbishment activities: Manage our assembly and refurbishment partners, own the bills of material for everything we build from purchased components as well as internal refurbishment within our locations. Own the systems, not just the process: Take full responsibility for our ERP and warehouse management setup for all supply chain topics, from data model and master data through to daily execution – you will be the business owner to our software team and guide implementation. Professionalize the structure: Design and implement the processes, controls and physical setup our growing operation needs, and then get your hands dirty making them real and ensuring your organization internalizes them. Own the numbers behind the goods: You will guide the rest of the company on such topics as transfer prices, landed cost allocation and other supply-chain related financials, ensuring each business line's P&L is accurately reflecting parts consumption and asset usage – together with our Finance team. Drive the agenda across teams: Set priorities, align Hardware, Finance and Tech behind them, and hold the line when it matters. Partner with the larger organization and understand your impact on them: All you do, you do with the end goal in mind to become the best friend of our Local and Country Operations and Sales teams, who all depend on your fulfillment excellence to grow and maintain their businesses. Lead and grow your team: Build a supply chain organization that scales with us across markets. Your skills and qualifications We are looking for someone who has built structure inside a well-run company and is ready to build it again from scratch, with their sleeves rolled up. Ideally you bring: 10+ years of relevant professional experience, of which at least 5 in a managerial supply chain or operations role. Experience leading a team of at least 3 direct reports in a supply chain or operations-heavy function. Structure from an established company: You have worked inside proper processes and systems and know what good looks like. 0 to 1 experience: You have also built something from nothing in a smaller or fast-moving company or demonstrated you can excel in such a setting, and you are comfortable being scrappy when that is what the situation needs. Commercial and financial fluency: Working capital optimization, inter-company transactions or product costing, are all familiar territory for you. Cross-functional communication: You can carry a topic across teams and drive it to a decision. Ownership and a firm, professional attitude: You take the whole problem, not your part of it. English at C1 level or above Nice to have: Hands-on experience with Odoo or a comparable ERP, ideally including experience in shaping or designing a system for supply chain topics rather than execution alone. Background in bike, scooter, mobility or another hardware-heavy industry where physical goods move between internal as well as external locations. German or Dutch What you can expect from us Exciting industry: You will work in the dynamic world of mobility, which is a constantly evolving sector. Real impact: Your work improves the lives of many bike couriers. Take on immediate responsibility: Start making a difference right away and implement your own ideas. Boredom? Not a chance! Shape the future: As part of our growing start-up, you will help to shape tomorrow's mobility. International team & Strong network: Work alongside motivated colleagues from all over the world. Teamwork is very important to us. Fair conditions: We offer a stable employment with attractive salary, €50 HRmony voucher , a company e-bike, modern equipment and 28 days' holiday a year. Your skills and qualifications

We are looking for someone who has built structure inside a well-run company and is ready to build it again from scratch, with their sleeves rolled up. Ideally you bring:

title: Werkstudent im Bereich Legal / Compliance (d/m/w)
description: Ihre Aufgaben Bei NYALA begleitest Du die Weiterentwicklung unseres Angebots von juristischer Seite. Du lernst, regulatorische Anforderungen umzusetzen sowie zu diesen mit den Aufsichtsbehörden zu kommunizieren. Dabei wendest Du den bestehenden Rechtsrahmen aus eWpG, eWpRV, KWG und GwG an, entwickelst unsere Produkte in diesem weiter, begleitest mit uns aktuelle Entwicklungen bei der Gesetzgebung und nimmst über Stellungnahmen und Konsultationen aktiv Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung der Gesetzgebung zur Blockchain-Technologie. Du hast damit nicht nur die Möglichkeit, die geltenden Regelungen auf konkrete Sachverhalte im Unternehmen anzuwenden (und das anders als in der Kanzlei umfassend und gestaltend, nicht nur im Rahmen eines beschränkten Beratungsauftrags), sondern auch zukünftige Entwicklungen aktiv mitzugestalten. Im operativen Tagesgeschäft arbeitest du direkt dem Geldwäsche-, Compliance- und Risikobeauftragten zu, bereitest Sachverhalte entscheidungsreif auf und hältst Fristen, Maßnahmen und Wiedervorlagen nach. Im Schwerpunkt des Berichtswesens erstellst du Vorlagen für die Berichte an Funktionsträger im Unternehmen, pflegst Kennzahlen und Auswertungen, hältst Richtlinien, Handbücher und Arbeitsanweisungen aktuell und unterstützt bei Jahresabschluss- und Sonderprüfungen. Ihr Profil Du brennst für Technologie und speziell DLT, glaubst an die revolutionäre Chance der Blockchain im Finanzsystem und hast Interesse an kapitalmarktrechtlichen Fragestellungen. Vollständige Vorkenntnisse in eWpG, GwG und KWG erwarten wir nicht; ein großer Teil dieses Rechtsrahmens ist selbst erst wenige Jahre alt und entwickelt sich beständig weiter. Wir erwarten Sorgfalt im Detail, Verbindlichkeit bei Fristen, die Fähigkeit, komplizierte Sachverhalte knapp und nachvollziehbar zu verschriftlichen, und Diskretion im Umgang mit Kunden- und Unternehmensdaten. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch ist für Aufsichtskorrespondenz und im Meldewesen erforderlich, Englisch für Korrespondenz mit internationalen Kunden und für die Interpretation von Rechtstexten von Vorteil. Warum wir? Compliance ist bei uns nicht nur nachgelagerte Kontrollinstanz, sondern Voraussetzung des Geschäftsmodells: ohne belastbare Registerführung und rechtssichere Verfahrensabläufe gibt es kein Kryptowertpapier. Du arbeitest deshalb nicht an einem Ausschnitt, sondern siehst den vollständigen Zyklus – von der Anbahnung eines Emittenten über die Aufnahme in das Register bis zur Berichterstattung an Geschäftsführung und Aufsicht. Die Smart Registry als Institut bietet hervorragende Voraussetzungen, über den Tellerrand zu schauen: Viele unserer Produkte werden durch neue Gesetze erst ermöglicht und erst in Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden entwickelt. Wir waren im Februar 2024 der erste Kryptowertpapierregisterführer, welche elektronische Aktien nach dem eWpG eingetragen hat. Werde Teil eines motivierten, technikbegeisterten und internationalen Teams mit starker Unternehmenskultur direkt am Ku'damm in Berlin. Wir bieten dir Einarbeitung unmittelbar durch die Beauftragten, direkten Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – und die Perspektive, in Themen eigenverantwortlich hineinzuwachsen. Wer eine große, arbeitsteilige Compliance-Abteilung sucht, ist bei uns falsch; wer früh Verantwortung und einen ungewöhnlich vollständigen Blick auf ein reguliertes Geschäft will, richtig. Deine Kolleginnen, Kollegen und Kunden sind direkt erreichbar, Feedback bekommst du auf kurzem und direktem Weg.
  • Deine Designs bleiben nicht in Figma: Mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui) bringst du sie selbst ins Frontend und setzt Teil-Features, teils auch ganze Features, gemeinsam mit dem Team um. Du musst kein Programmierer sein, aber du willst, dass deine Arbeit im Produkt landet, und legst dafür selbst Hand an.
  • Ein besonderes Feld ist Design für KI-Agenten: Du gestaltest Interaktionsmuster für Workflows, in denen Agenten Aufgaben übernehmen. Wo braucht der Nutzer Kontrolle, wo Transparenz? Muster, für die es noch kaum Vorbilder gibt.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktdesign, gern mit B2B-Software oder komplexen Workflows.
  • Ein Portfolio mit 2 bis 3 Case Studies, die deinen Weg von der Nutzerfrage bis zum ausgelieferten Interface zeigen: Deine Denkweise interessiert uns mehr als die Menge an Screens.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma, von Wireframes über klickbare Prototypen bis zur Komponentenbibliothek.
  • Erfahrung mit qualitativem Research: Interviews führen, Erkenntnisse verdichten, Annahmen mit Usability-Tests prüfen.
  • Gespür für Interaction Design und Informationsarchitektur in datenreichen Anwendungen.
  • Gute bis sehr gute Praxis mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, v0): Du bringst Teil-Features oder ganze Features selbst in den Code.
  • Solide Grundlagen in HTML und CSS, JavaScript ist ein Plus.

  • Eine seltene Ausgangslage. Wir bauen Software für ein Geschäftsmodell, das bereits funktioniert, und wissen, dass sie gebraucht wird. Du erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie sich eine ganze Branche neu erfindet, und gestaltest das aktiv mit.

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join the AI Team working on our AI Medical Companion.
Your mission will be to build and optimize the data foundations that power safe, scalable, and impactful AI models. You will work on data infrastructure for LLM, VLM, and RAG-based systems, ensuring our engineers and data scientists can train, evaluate, and deploy AI models efficiently on high-quality, well-structured, and compliant data.   • Optimize performance and cost of data pipelines using GCP native services (BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Vertex AI)

You bring ideas, not tickets, and you want to help build a team, not just a network. A clear, direct communicator who's comfortable with partners' engineers and with our founders.
