title: Sales Engineer, Banking
description:
Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide.

About the Role

The Sales Engineer, Banking is a technically credible, commercially aware member of the EMEA SE team, responsible for the full technical sales cycle across banking opportunities in Western and Central Europe.

This is not a generalist SE role. You will be expected to engage deeply with treasury operations leads, custody technologists, CISOs, and risk committees inside Tier 1 and Tier 2 banks. You will need to understand how institutional banking technology works — core banking platforms, custody and settlement infrastructure, ISO 20022 and SWIFT messaging, and post-trade workflows — and be able to position Fireblocks clearly within that context. You will work closely with Banking-aligned Sales Directors across your region, taking primary responsibility for technical qualification, PoC delivery, RFP responses, and solution design from first engagement through to onboarding handoff.

What You'll Do

Technical Pre-Sales

  • Lead technical qualification for banking opportunities, distinguishing genuine digital asset programmes from exploratory noise
  • Deliver tailored product demonstrations to technical and executive audiences across custody, settlement, treasury, and compliance use cases
  • Scope, design, and deliver Proofs of Concept in bank environments — including navigating infosec review, sandbox provisioning, and API integration testing
  • Produce and own RFP, RFI, and DDQ responses for banking prospects, maintaining accuracy against Fireblocks' external security and compliance attestations
  • Present Fireblocks' security architecture to CISOs, CROs, risk committees, and product and business line leads with appropriate institutional credibility

Solution Design & Client Engagement

  • Translate institutional banking requirements — custody flows, settlement logic, treasury management, regulatory reporting — into Fireblocks solution architectures
  • Engage directly with bank technology teams on API integration patterns, core banking middleware, and operational workflow design
  • Co-develop technical account plans with Sales Directors, identifying the path from initial engagement to production deployment
  • Contribute to deal strategy on competitive situations, particularly against technology-first custody competitors

Cross-Functional Contribution

  • Act as the voice of the banking client in internal product and roadmap discussions
  • Contribute reusable technical content — solution briefs, reference architectures, PoC templates — that scale across the Banking vertical
  • Support onboarding handoff to Professional Services, ensuring continuity from sales into delivery
  • Participate in the EMEA SE enablement programme, contributing to banking-specific sessions and peer knowledge transfer

What You'll Bring

  • 3–8 years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role, selling into or supporting Tier 1 or Tier 2 banks, financial market infrastructure, or capital markets firms
  • Direct experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles in regulated financial institutions
  • Demonstrable track record of scoping and delivering PoCs or technical pilots in bank environments
  • Experience authoring RFP/RFI responses and engaging with bank procurement, legal, and infosec processes
  • Exposure to digital asset, tokenisation, or blockchain initiatives whether from a technology vendor, infrastructure provider, or within a bank's innovation function

Technical Knowledge

  • Working understanding of institutional banking architecture: core banking platforms (Temenos, Finastra, Murex, Calypso or similar), custody infrastructure, or post-trade settlement systems
  • Familiarity with financial messaging standards: ISO 20022, SWIFT MT/MX, or equivalent settlement and payment protocols
  • Comfort with API-led integration patterns; able to engage credibly in technical discussions with bank engineering and middleware teams
  • Understanding of cryptographic key management concepts, hardware security modules, or MPC/TSS architecture (formal training provided)
  • Awareness of MiCA, DORA, or equivalent EMEA regulatory requirements as they affect digital asset operations in banks

Skills & Attributes

  • Credible with senior institutional stakeholders CISO, CTO, Head of Digital Assets, treasury operations leads, and product and business line owners — not only with technical teams
  • Structured, precise communicator: able to write clearly, present confidently, and adapt register for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Commercially aware: understands deal economics, qualification discipline, and what constitutes productive SE engagement
  • Self-directed and organised, capable of running multiple active opportunities simultaneously without close supervision
  • A European language an advantage

It is not typical for a candidate to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and each compensation decision is dependent on each individual case. A reasonable base salary range estimate for this position is €80,000 – €110,000. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which for some roles may include a target bonus, a very competitive equity grant, and very generous benefits.

title: Director of Operations, Payments EMEA
description:
Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide.

Role Overview

Fireblocks Liechtenstein Ltd. is a payment institution being established to provide Account Information Services (AIS) and Payment Initiation Services (PIS) to institutional clients across the European Economic Area, under authorisation from the Liechtenstein Financial Market Authority (FMA). 

The Director of Operations is a controlling-function role and a member of the Company’s executive management. The role holds primary day-to-day accountability for the sound operation of the licensed entity, acts as the principal local point of contact with the FMA, and provides the substance and operational governance that underpin the Company’s authorisation. 

The role has a defined and focused scope: the Company provides AIS and PIS services, with its technology platform operated by an intra-group technology provider. The Director of Operations is responsible for governing that arrangement and ensuring the entity operates soundly, rather than for building or running technology directly. The role may also support the Fireblocks group’s wider regulated activities where relevant.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory and Governance

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day point of contact with the FMA for operational matters, managing the ongoing supervisory relationship.
  • Ensure the Company operates at all times within the scope and conditions of its authorisation.
  • Own the Company’s regulatory reporting obligations and coordinate the annual statutory and regulatory audit.
  • Support the Board and executive management in discharging their governance responsibilities, including preparation and follow-through on Board matters.

Operational Oversight

  • Hold day-to-day accountability for the operational delivery of the Company’s AIS and PIS services.
  • Oversee the outsourcing arrangement with the technology provider, including monitoring of service levels, quarterly service reviews, and management of the outsourcing register and sub-outsourcing controls.
  • Own the Company’s business continuity and incident management framework, acting as the escalation and decision point in the event of a material disruption.
  • Oversee the segregated operational processes that support the Company’s regulatory perimeter, including customer onboarding, support routing, and data governance in coordination with the Risk & Compliance function.

Risk and Control

  • Work closely with the Risk & Compliance function to ensure an effective control environment across AML/CFT, operational, ICT, and outsourcing risk.
  • Ensure the Company meets its obligations under applicable Liechtenstein and EEA regulation, including PSD2/ZDG and, as applicable, DORA.
  • Oversee the maintenance of the Company’s risk register and the periodic and permanent control framework.

Commercial and Financial Governance

  • Oversee the commercial and financial governance of the entity, including the intra-group service arrangements, in coordination with group finance.
  • Provide operational sign-off on customer onboarding to the entity, ensuring the dual-entity contracting process is completed and customers are correctly provisioned.
  • Support the Fireblocks group’s wider regulated activities where relevant, bringing operational and regulatory experience to bear. 

Candidate Profile

  • Proven operational leadership experience within a regulated financial institution — a payment institution, e-money institution, bank, or crypto-asset service provider.
  • Experience of the Liechtenstein or wider EEA regulatory environment, ideally including prior involvement in a licence application and ongoing regulator engagement.
  • A payments background, with an understanding of open banking (AIS/PIS), payment operations, and the associated regulatory obligations.
  • Familiarity with outsourcing governance and the operation of a licensed entity that relies on an intra-group or third-party technology provider.
  • Exposure to the digital asset sector is an advantage.

Attributes

  • The standing and seniority to act credibly as a controlling function before the FMA.
  • Sound judgement, personal accountability, and the ability to operate as the responsible individual for a licensed entity.
  • Able to work effectively with a distributed group, including colleagues in other time zones.
  • Fit and proper for a controlling-function role, satisfying the FMA’s suitability assessment.

Location and Presence

The role does not require full-time residence in Liechtenstein. The successful candidate may be resident in Liechtenstein or a neighbouring jurisdiction (Switzerland).The candidate must be willing to travel to Liechtenstein as required and to accommodate periodic working hours aligned with a US-headquartered group.

title: Mid Market Account Executive - DACH
description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:
Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers.

While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €10k to €300k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if: 

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

    • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
    • Get In Early: The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. 
    • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.

Minimum Requirements for the role:

  • Winning DNA: Min.18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Over-achievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt
  • Native German language speakers

Advantageous:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don’t rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. title: Werkstudent:in Business Consultancy
description: Über Northwave Unternehmen zu schützen, ist unsere Mission. Bei Northwave verändern 275+ Cyber Security-Spezialist:innen die Art und Weise, wie Unternehmen und Organisationen digitale Sicherheit denken und umsetzen. Mit unserem Hauptsitz in Utrecht, unserem DACH-Headquarter in Leipzig sowie Standorten in Österreich, Schweden und Belgien sind wir europaweit vertreten. Northwave verbindet Expertise im Ethical Hacking mit Erkenntnissen aus der Verhaltenspsychologie und modernstem Security Management auf höchstem Niveau. Wir reagieren nicht nur auf Bedrohungen, sondern erkennen sie frühzeitig. Mit unseren 24/7 Managed Security Services und maßgeschneiderten Lösungen begleiten wir unsere Kund:innen auf ihrem individuellen Weg zu mehr Sicherheit. Wenn Du Teil von Northwave wirst, arbeitest Du in einem Umfeld, in dem Innovation zu echten Ergebnissen führt. Bei uns entwickelst Du Deine Expertise weiter und trägst aktiv dazu bei, die Zukunft der digitalen Sicherheit in unterschiedlichsten Branchen mitzugestalten. Deine Mission Du willst nicht einfach nur Akten wälzen, sondern die echte Welt der strategischen Management- und IT-Beratung hautnah kennenlernen? Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) in unserem Business Security Consulting Team arbeitest du direkt mit unserem Head of Consultancy DACH zusammen. Deine Mission ist es, die Brücke zwischen strategischen Geschäftszielen und den Herausforderungen der Cybersecurity zu schlagen. Du musst an Tag 1 kein technischer Deep-Dive-Experte sein – was für uns zählt, ist dein Drive, dein analytischer Verstand und dein Verständnis für Geschäftsmodelle. Deine Aufgaben: Sparringspartner in Training: Du unterstützt den Head of Consultancy direkt im strategischen Tagesgeschäft und bei der Steuerung des DACH-Beratungsgeschäfts. Consulting hautnah: Du begleitest Kundenprojekte in den Bereichen Cybersecurity-Strategie, Risikomanagement und Compliance (z.B. NIS2, CRA, ISO 27001) und lernst das Handwerkszeug der Top-Beratung von der Pike auf. Business & Cyber: Du analysierst Geschäftsmodelle, bereitest Marktrecherchen auf und hilfst dabei, abstrakte Bedrohungen in pragmatische, wertschöpfende Strategien für das C-Level zu übersetzen. Content Creation: Du erstellst Management-Präsentationen, Reports und Workshop-Materialien, die komplexe Sachverhalte auf den Punkt bringen. Das erwartet Dich bei uns Das Wichtigste zuerst: Dein Studium steht an erster Stelle. Daher findet die Abstimmung deiner Arbeitszeiten immer im Austausch mit dir und unter Berücksichtigung deines Semesterplans statt. Zudem bieten wir dir einen attraktiven Stundenlohn (über Mindestlohn) und sechs Wochen Urlaub im Jahr. Unser Büro ist mit Apple Geräten , höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen und einem stets mit kühlen Getränken gefüllten Kühlschrank ausgestattet. Ach ja, und es gibt regelmäßig Merch im Northwave Design, sowie Kuchen und niederländische Karamellwaffeln . Bei Northwave bist du Teil eines internationalen Teams aus Security-Enthusiat:innen, die gerne ihr Wissen teilen und sich über Unterstützung z.B. beim Firmenlauf oder dem Pub Quiz freuen. In Deutschland befinden wir uns noch im Aufbau - deine Chance also, mitzugestalten. Lust auf Beratung: Du hast den absoluten Willen, die Consulting-Welt zu erobern und bist bereit, dich mit Hands-on-Mentalität in neue, komplexe Themenstellungen einzuarbeiten. Mindset & Drive: Begeisterungsfähigkeit, grenzenlose Neugier und ein extrem hoher Lernwille sind für dich selbstverständlich. Business First: Du besitzt ein ausgeprägtes betriebswirtschaftliches Denken. Ein echtes Interesse für Cybersecurity ist Pflicht – genauso wichtig ist aber das Verständnis dafür, dass IT-Sicherheit immer auch einen "Business Value" liefern muss. Background: Eingeschrieben an einer Hochschule? Check. Was genau du studierst (von Kunstgeschichte bis Informatik), ist uns dabei völlig egal. Wir suchen keine reinen Theorie-Experten, sondern Macher mit Hands-on-Mentalität und einem messerscharfen Verstand. Skills: Du bringst eine strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse mit. Perspektive: Du wirst Teil eines internationalen Teams von Cybersecurity-Enthusiasten. Da unsere deutsche Organisation kontinuierlich wächst, hast du die einmalige Chance, unsere Zukunft mitzugestalten und dich langfristig bei uns weiterzuentwickeln. Interessiert? Du bist Dir noch nicht ganz sicher? Dann schau Dir an, wie das Arbeiten bei Northwave aussieht: Karriere bei Northwave .   • Own the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all financial transactions across Filigran entities

  • Lead consolidation across Filigran's growing international entity structure (including new entity set-ups as the company expands)

  • Partner with the VP of Finance on transfer pricing, inter company transactions, and cross-border compliance matters

  • Perform ongoing gap analyses of accounting processes and proactively design and implement internal controls and policies

  • Manage the yearly financial audit end-to-end, acting as the primary point of contact for auditors

  • Own the relationship with the external accounting firm, holding them to a high standard of accuracy and responsiveness

Systems & Scalability

  • Build documentation that make the accounting function auditable and transferable

Leadership & Cross-Functional Support

  • Act as a thought partner to the VP of Finance on technical accounting matters and process design

  • Manage a current team of 3 general accountants.

  • Support ad hoc business requests, including finance topics adjacent to accounting (e.g., payroll coordination)

  • 10+ years in accounting roles, including senior/lead or controller-level experience

  • Strong knowledge of French accounting standards; exposure to multi-GAAP/consolidation environments is a strong plus

title: Staff Cloud Architect
description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

Are you interested in pioneering and breaking new ground in large-scale financial data processing? Then this role might be for you. Join the Ripple Treasury Reconciliation team where you’ll be solving complex problems and having fun while passionately discussing (and arguing) with your team members!

About the Reconciliation team

Ripple Treasury Reconciliation platform sits at the heart of how the world's largest financial institutions and enterprises close their books and bring more control to their financial processes. Our vision is to create a completely new user experience with financial tools that have no equals on the market. With users first in mind and driven by technology.

As part of Ripple, we're backed by the scale and ambition of a company reshaping global finance, giving our team the resources to modernize the mission-critical product while still moving with the speed and ownership of a smaller engineering group. If you want your code to directly touch how billions of transactions get reconciled every day, this is that kind of role. 

What we are looking for

We are looking for a Staff Infrastructure Architect to own the infrastructure of our growing Reconciliation platform. You'll set the direction, architecture and design for our platform, focusing on performance, stability, security and how to integrate newer technologies. You will also be setting the technical direction and standards for our team while working alongside senior infrastructure engineers who own day-to-day execution and operational work.

This is a hands-on architecture role, not a pure strategy or management position. You'll write core foundational code and build reference implementations, but the bulk of routine implementation work belongs to the team. Your value is in judgment: knowing where to invest based on business direction, designing for scalability and lower long-term maintenance burden, and raising the technical ceiling of the team.

What you'll do:

  • Set and own infrastructure architecture direction. Drive architecture, scalability, and performance decisions across the platform. 
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to senior infrastructure engineers by reviewing designs, unblocking hard problems, and playing a key role in deepening the team's expertise.
  • Establish infrastructure standards and patterns for the team to create a high benchline for quality, performance and maintenance of the system.
  • Stay hands-on: prototype, build critical-path components, and get into the code where it matters while routine implementation and day-to-day operational work is owned by the senior engineers.
  • Make and be accountable for infrastructure tradeoff decisions with long-term cost, scalability, or maintainability implications.

What you'll bring:

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience designing and owning large-scale distributed infrastructure, including a track record of owning architecture decisions yourself, with 4+ years serving as a technical lead and mentoring engineers.
  • Deep expertise with AWS & Kubernetes. Minimum 5+ years experience with each.
  • Expertise in Linux and Windows server environments, with strong experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure.
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and ArgoCD, and scripting languages including Bash and Python.
  • Experience with data infrastructure and processing technologies such as Spark and MSSQL. Experience building the systems that power high-volume transactional workloads, ideally in finance space. Cybersecurity experience is a plus.
  • A track record of building infrastructure that scales, stays available, and remains secure, using Agile practices to ship reliably.

About you:

  • You work openly and collaboratively with diverse teams, and you're energized by driving engineering excellence through better standards, processes, and shared knowledge.
  • You welcome constructive feedback, actively inviting debate and rigorous discussion around your architectural ideas to deliver optimal outcomes.

 

This role is architecture-led, not implementation-led — we're looking for someone who has owned and been accountable for infrastructure design decisions, not someone whose primary experience is executing infrastructure designed by others. This is also a technical leadership role, not a people-management position. 

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London or Remote (UK) | 💰£70,000 - £105,000 + Benefits |

We’re looking for several Senior Product Marketing Managers to own Product Marketing for some of Monzo's most important products across Core Banking, Borrowing and Wealth

At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers, and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead campaign & channel strategy, creative direction, and overall go-to-market approach to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we build the right products and drive their growth. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll own Product Marketing for a product end-to-end: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and helping bring launches to market. There are two levels of seniority available — we will determine together what best fits you during the interview process.

Where you could join:

  • Core is the foundation of Monzo. It's where we build the products millions of people use every day: from Current Accounts and Joint Accounts to Pots, Subscriptions, Savings Challenge, and all the moments that make managing money feel effortless. This is a role for someone who believes the best product experiences come from getting the fundamentals right, and wants to shape products that become part of people's daily lives.
  • Borrowing is helping customers access credit simply, transparently, and responsibly. Today that includes growing products like Flex, Loans, Credit Insights, Mortgages, and Overdrafts in the UK, while also taking Monzo's Flex proposition to millions more customers across Europe. This is a role for someone excited by the challenge of growing an established proposition at home while shaping how it succeeds in new markets; understanding local customer needs, refining the proposition, and helping build the foundations for Monzo to win internationally.
  • Wealth is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work and make growing money feel simpler, more accessible, and more rewarding for everyday customers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Product Marketing for a Product. You'll define a 2–4 quarter Product Marketing strategy that connects customer needs, market opportunity, and product direction into a clear plan. You'll own Product Marketing across the full product lifecycle from early discovery through launches and iteration. You'll be the go-to person for understanding how your product succeeds in the market.
  • Become the expert on your market. You'll build a deep understanding of your customers, competitors, and category, using research, data, and experimentation to identify opportunities that influence product priorities. You'll bring the voice of the market into day-to-day product decisions and help your squad make better bets.
  • Define positioning customers understand. You'll create clear, differentiated positioning and messaging that helps customers understand why your product matters. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Writers, and Integrated Marketing to ensure that positioning is reflected consistently across the product experience and everything customers see.
  • Influence Product Strategy. You'll work alongside Product Managers, Designers, and Researchers to shape product strategy with customer and market insight. Product teams will seek your perspective before committing to product bets, and you'll help turn customer problems into products people genuinely love.
  • Shape successful launches. You'll design launch strategies that fit the customer problem, partner with Integrated Marketing on campaigns, and coordinate cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Operations, and Support. You'll measure what worked, learn quickly, and continuously improve how your product reaches customers.
  • Measure what matters. You'll use customer and commercial data to understand whether your work is making a difference. You'll build business cases for product decisions, measure launches against meaningful outcomes, and use what you learn to strengthen positioning, propositions, and future product decisions.

This is for you if: 

  • You enjoy owning entire products. You're comfortable taking responsibility for Product Marketing across a full product experience, from customer insight through to positioning. 
  • You solve ambiguous problems with evidence. You enjoy understanding customers, identifying market opportunities and turning insight into practical product and marketing recommendations.
  • You know what makes products win. You combine customer insight, market understanding and commercial thinking to build products and propositions people genuinely love.
  • You influence through collaboration. You enjoy working closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, Researchers and Integrated Marketing, bringing people with you through evidence rather than authority.
  • You're always improving and helping others improve. You seek feedback, develop your craft and contribute to making the team stronger through sharing knowledge and helping others. Mentor more junior team members informally.

 

The Interview Process

Our interview process involves three main stages:

  • Initial Call (30mins) 
  • Case Study Presentation (45mins)
  • x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! 

We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.

You’ll hear from us throughout the application process, but if you’ve got any questions, please reach out to ----- You can also use this email address to let us know if there’s anything we can do to make the process easier for you because of disability, neurodiversity or anything else.

What’s in it for you:

  • £70,000 - £105,000 as a base salary
  • This role will be based out of our London office next to Liverpool Street station in a hybrid approach of office based and home working, or remotely within the UK 
  • We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.
  • Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences 
  • And much more, see our full list of benefits here 

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Xero, plus experience with accounts production and tax software such as TaxCalc, CCH or IRIS

  • Highly organised, with the ability to manage multiple clients, competing priorities and statutory deadlines

  • A collaborative, client-first mindset, comfortable working cross-functionally within a scaling business

description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on the runtime systems of a novel search engine tailored for agentic AI consumption.

In this role, you will focus on building low-latency, high-throughput systems that serve search queries in real time. You will work on the critical path of user-facing requests, where performance, predictability, and efficiency directly impact product quality. You will design and operate systems that handle thousands of requests per second under strict latency budgets, optimising every layer from request handling to data access and response assembly.

In this position, your responsibility will be to

  • Design, implement, and operate core runtime services for serving search queries at scale
  • Build and optimise request flows, including query processing, retrieval orchestration, and response assembly under strict latency budgets
  • Develop systems that maintain performance and predictability under high load
  • Optimise CPU, memory, and data access patterns in performance-critical paths
  • Ensure reliability, observability, and predictability across production services

  • Monitor throughput, latency, and resource usage, and drive improvements in performance and cost efficiency
  • Collaborate with indexing and ML teams to integrate retrieval and ranking components, keeping ML logic decoupled from core system internals
  • Support experimentation and iteration through controlled rollouts and rigorous benchmarking

You may be a good fit if you:

  • Have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer working on production backend systems
  • Have strong hands-on expertise in C++ or Rust in real-world, high-load services
  • Have built and operated high-load, low-latency user-facing systems handling thousands of RPS under strict latency constraints
  • Understand performance at a systems level — CPU, memory, networking, and data access
  • Have operated your own code in production: deployed it, debugged incidents, and rolled back changes when necessary
  • Think end-to-end about request flows rather than staying within isolated components
  • Can balance correctness, latency, and development velocity, making pragmatic tradeoffs when scope or time requires
  • Collaborate effectively across engineering, ML, and product teams, communicating clearly in cross-functional settings

Strong candidates may also have experience with:

  • DBMS internals (open source or SaaS) and cloud infrastructure
  • High-load web applications or large-scale APIs
  • Performance-critical systems such as trading platforms or real-time data pipelines
  • Low-level performance tuning and hardware-level optimisation

Artefact is a next-generation strategy and data consulting firm dedicated to transforming organisations through data and AI. We combine the rigour of top-tier strategy consulting with deep expertise in data, digital and analytics to help clients achieve tangible business impact.

With 2,500+ consultants, data scientists and engineers, we work with global leaders such as Samsung, L’Oréal, Orange and Sanofi. Our Swiss offices are at the heart of Artefact’s growth, advising clients on their most pressing strategic challenges — from AI strategy and governance to digital transformation roadmaps and new business model design.

Main Responsibilities

As a Senior Consultant in our Zurich/Lausanne office, you will work at the intersection of strategy consulting and data and AI delivery. You will:

  • Strategy Development: Work with client leadership teams to address high-stakes questions. How can AI reshape our business model? How should we govern and organise for data? Which strategic programmes deliver the most impact?
  • Structured Problem-Solving: Break complex challenges down into decisions a client can act on, combining consulting rigour with a working knowledge of what current AI can and cannot actually do.
  • Solution Design: Turn a business question into a solution shape — what data it depends on, what kind of platform or product it should sit on, and what “good” looks like once it is built. You will do this alongside our data scientists and engineers.
  • Project Delivery: Support engagements end to end, from hypothesis framing and market and competitor analysis through to data maturity assessments, client workshops, governance design and implementation roadmaps.
  • Client Engagement: Work closely with C-level stakeholders and business unit leaders. You will build trusted relationships, communicate recommendations with clarity, and keep the work aligned to what the client is actually trying to decide.
  • Knowledge & Practice Building: Contribute to the growth of Artefact's Zurich office by shaping new offerings, creating intellectual capital - frameworks, thought pieces, benchmarks - and taking part in business development.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who can hold a technical position and a commercial one at the same time. The strongest candidates meet most of the following.

  • Education: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Business, Economics or a related field.
  • Work Experience: Around three to five years in consulting, or in a technical/date-focussed role with client-facing responsibility. 
  • Business Acumen & AI Fluency: A genuine dual affinity for business and technology. You are comfortable with modern data and AI concepts - generative AI and LLMs, retrieval, predictive machine learning, cloud platforms - and with what they cost and where they fail, not only with what they are called.
  • Technical Depth: You have built AI or data products, not only advised on them. You can explain why you chose which model you put on which part of the work, and what that choice did to both output quality and cost. You will not be writing production code in this role, but you should have the basic understanding.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Strong quantitative and analytical skills, and the judgement to know which number actually decides the question. You are comfortable getting to a defensible estimate with your assumptions stated out loud.
  • Communication & Interpersonal Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication. You enjoy working in teams and in front of clients.
  • Languages: Fluency in German/French and English, written and spoken, is strongly preferred.. 
  • Work Eligibility: You must be eligible to work in Switzerland.

Why Join Us

  • Strategy and the Build: Artefact is neither a traditional strategy consultancy nor a pure technology player. You will move between the boardroom and the build, and be expected to be credible in both.
  • Engineers, not hand-offs: Our 2,500 people include the data scientists and engineers you will work beside on the same engagement - not a delivery organisation you hand a slide deck to.
  • Zurich Office Impact: As part of a growing Swiss team you will have visibility and impact from the first day. You will help shape Artefact's footprint in the region and work directly with senior leadership.
  • Learning & Growth: Regular training in both consulting method and AI and data capability, combined with international exposure.
  • Culture of Doers: Innovation, action, collaboration. We are entrepreneurial and fast-moving, committed to delivering impact while supporting each other's growth.

This position is based in Zürich or Lausanne.

title: Staff Design Verification Engineer, AI HW
description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Our Tensix team is building custom AI compute cores, RISC-V CPUs, and chiplet-based architectures for datacenter, edge, and automotive AI. Design Verification Engineers on this team validate compute IP and subsystems and build scalable DV infrastructure to keep verification fast, automated, and production-grade.

This role is hybrid, based out of Toronto, ON, Austin, TX or Belgrade, Serbia.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

 

Who You Are

  • Experienced in modern verification methodologies with strong SystemVerilog skills and exposure to structured testbench development.
  • Comfortable working from block-level to system-level verification and reasoning about microarchitecture behavior from specs and waveforms.
  • Proficient in Linux environments with Python, or Bash scripting for automate builds, parse logs, manage CI pipelines.
  • Skilled in coverage-driven verification and confident debugging across RTL, testbench, and workload scenarios.
  • Motivated by AI hardware and eager to learn verification strategies for new architectures and domains.

What We Need

  • Contribute to verification of Tensix IP and subsystems from early planning through tape-out, owning coverage goals and driving them to closure.
  • Build and maintain reusable verification environments, agents, scoreboards, and supporting infrastructure in SystemVerilog and Python.
  • Develop constrained-random and directed tests and close functional, code, and assertion coverage using data-driven approaches.
  • Debug complex issues across RTL and testbench while collaborating with design, firmware, compiler, and architecture teams.
  • Help evolve DV infrastructure including regression flows, CI/CD integration, EDA compute environments, and reproducible setups.
  • Nice to have: Exposure to functional safety (FuSa) verification concepts for automotive AI workloads.
  • Nice to have: Familiarity with formal verification methodologies, SVA (SystemVerilog Assertions), or formal property verification for complex control logic and microarchitectural corner cases.

What You Will Learn

  • How Tenstorrent verifies AI-native compute architectures including Tensix cores, RISC-V CPUs, matrix units, vector units, and datapath.
  • How simulation, emulation, and software-driven workloads combine to validate both functional correctness and performance.
  • How numerical precision formats such as BF16, FP4, and INT8 and on-chip dataflow impact verification complexity and coverage strategy.
  • How to build scalable DV infrastructure across hybrid compute environments including containerized regression systems.
  • How data analytics and modern AI tooling can enhance verification workflows and accelerate convergence.

 

 

Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made.

Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer.

This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology.  Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2).   These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S.  As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency.  If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

title: Principal Data Strategist (m/f/d)
description:
Principal data strategists at Thoughtworks are experienced consultants who work with clients to create winning data solutions that meet business goals. They play a pivotal role in developing modern data architecture approaches that directly address our clients' key business objectives. Their responsibilities span in-depth reviews of current data and technology strategy, targeted data strategy, guiding clients to unlock the full potential of data, and providing high-level roadmaps.

This role entails a mix of advisory responsibilities in data strategy and governance, coupled with a solid delivery-lead role and a breadth of data and AI ecosystem expertise.

This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation to manage. The role is based in Germany and requires regular travel to client sites, up to approximately 50% of your time.

Job responsibilities

  • You will collaborate closely with clients to understand their business ecosystem and goals, and co-create data and technology strategies aligned with their objectives.
  • You will help define a clear vision for the client enterprise to become data-driven and aligned with the overall business strategy.
  • You will consult on complex data programs, providing technical leadership and guidance as a data subject-matter expert.
  • You will lead and interact with clients across various domains, addressing challenging problems, and collaborate with sales to turn them into viable solutions and winning proposals.
  • You will act as a translator between business, data and IT, and communicate data strategy to senior client stakeholders, including C-level.
  • You will own the creation of end-to-end viable data solutions, keeping in mind long-term impacts and overseeing program inceptions for new product development.
  • You will be responsible for formulating data governance strategies addressing security, privacy and compliance requirements.
  • You will enable capability building in data strategy and governance, growing the next generation of data strategists.
  • You will create differentiated assets in data strategy and governance to take to market.
  • You lead through influence rather than headcount: growing capability and raising delivery standards inside the organisation, while building our presence in the market through thought leadership, ecosystem initiatives and client-facing points of view.

Job qualifications

Technical Skills

  • You have extensive experience as a consultant, with a proven track record of creating data strategy and solutions that drive business value.
  • You have solid experience with data platforms and technologies, and can provide advisory and consultative guidance for clients and cross-delivery teams.
  • You have experience engaging with C-level stakeholders to influence and enable the operationalization of an enterprise-wide data strategy.
  • You have demonstrated leadership abilities, with the capacity to lead technical teams and drive projects to successful completion.
  • You are flexible and adaptable across a variety of projects, leveraging technical expertise and leadership to maximise impact.
  • You have a track record of ensuring proper data governance policies, including data lineage, quality checks and classification.
  • You have experience with AI and ML use cases and landscapes and can influence the build of the right solutions to harness insights from data.
  • You have experience building high-level solution frameworks, leveraging paradigms such as data-as-a-product and federated governance where needed.
  • You have professional working proficiency in German (B2 minimum, C1 strongly preferred) and can build consensus with mostly technical stakeholders. Exceptional candidates with outstanding data and AI consulting credentials may be considered where German is not yet at this level.

Consulting and commercial track record

  • You have worked in a consultancy or professional-services environment within the last five years, driving data and AI engagements end to end (recent examples matter more than historical ones).
  • You can point to data and AI pursuits you helped win and shape within the last three to five years, including deals from around €3M upwards, and you can speak concretely to their commercial shape, trade-offs and delivery.
  • You have grown a practice, capability or go-to-market asset, for example a reusable accelerator taken to market, combining solutioning, sales and delivery with tangible business outcomes.
  • You stay conversant with the technology and hands-on enough in at least one relevant area to earn technical credibility with client and delivery teams, while leading primarily on strategy and advisory.
  • You bring significant hands-on and leadership experience in data and AI (typically 10+ years) and, above all, the appetite to keep building: growing accounts, teams and capability rather than only overseeing them.

Professional Skills

  • You understand the importance of stakeholder management and can easily liaise between clients and other key stakeholders, ensuring buy-in and gaining trust along the way.
  • You are resilient in ambiguous situations and can adapt your role to approach challenges from multiple perspectives.
  • You don't shy away from risks or conflicts, instead you take them on and skillfully manage them.
  • You coach, mentor and motivate others and aspire to influence teammates to take positive action and accountability for their work.
  • You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change when needed.
  • Cultivating strong partnerships comes naturally to you; you understand how relationship building brings new opportunities to our business.
  • You have professional working proficiency in German (B2 minimum, C1 strongly preferred) and can build consensus with mostly technical stakeholders. Exceptional candidates with outstanding data and AI consulting credentials may be considered where German is not yet at this level.

Other things to know

Learning & Development

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment

At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.

Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment.

About Thoughtworks

Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we're pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we've delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let's be extraordinary.

title: Senior Software Engineer - REDAPL Graph Engine
description:
Please note that the job is only available from the locations outlined. 

 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help us take REDAPL, our Referential Data Platform, to the next level. REDAPL is Datadog's main platform for tracking our customers' infrastructure resources and relationships. The platform enables products where customers can understand, keep track of, and gain insights into their infrastructure related to performance, cost, security, and more.

Many Datadog products use REDAPL today such Cloud Security Posture Management, Resource Catalog, Cloud Cost Management, and Service Catalog and others - REDAPL ingests more than 4.5mil updates/second.

As a Senior Engineer, you will drive, lead and collaborate on projects both inside and outside the platform. You can expect to contribute to key technical decisions relating to our data ingestion, processing, and query pipelines.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Build a query engine that supports efficient relationship traversals for our most demanding workloads.
  • Contribute to design and drive high-priority, high-visibility projects to increase the platform's value, resilience, and scalability across multiple teams.
  • Lead and guide other engineers through architectural platform decisions
  • Identify potential system risks and trends in reliability and design solutions to address them
  • Provide input on prioritizing engineering-led initiatives in short- and long-term planning and roadmaps
  • Collaborate with internal product teams to understand their requirements and how we plan for their product growth as they integrate and depend on REDAPL

 

Who You Are:

  • You have a BS/MS/PhD in a Computer Science, Engineering or related scientific field or equivalent experience
  • You have worked extensively with multiple types of data stores. 
  • You have contributed to initiatives in a platform or infrastructure-focused environment for several years
  • You have led impactful technical initiatives in an environment where performance, cost efficiency, ease of use, and resilience/operability are first-order concerns
  • You have significant back-end engineering experience and have built, and operated distributed systems to solve problems at a high scale

Bonus points:

  • You have experience working with Graph Databases such as Neo4j, Memgraph, JanusGraph, ArangoDB, Amazon Neptune or PuppyGraph.
  • You have production-grade experience with Apache Iceberg
  • You have a solid grasp of query planning or better yet - contributed to a production-grade query engines or related projects (e.g. Trino, Calcite, Substrait, DataFusion, etc) ideally demonstrated through open-source contributions or PMC membership on projects.

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 

Benefits and Growth:

  • Get to build tools for software engineers, just like yourself. And use the tools we build to accelerate our development.
  • Have a lot of influence on product direction and impact on the business .
  • Work with skilled, knowledgeable, and kind teammates who are happy to teach and learn
  • Competitive global benefits
  • Continuous professional development

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

title: AI engineer (AI & GenAI) - People Domain
description:
Dans le cadre de l’ouverture d’un poste en CDI, nous recrutons un.e AI engineer, basé-e au choix à Paris.

 

🚀 CONTEXTE & ENJEUX STRATÉGIQUES

Au sein de Decathlon Digital, l'équipe People Data engage une initiative majeure : transformer l'expérience de nos 100 000 collaborateurs par l'intégration de l'IA Générative et Agentique.

Face à la fragmentation de l'écosystème RH dans plus de 70 pays, notre ambition est de construire une couche de simplification en s’appuyant sur les nouvelles solutions que proposent l’IA. Il s'agit d'une couche d'intelligence centralisée et agnostique des outils, capable d'interagir avec l'ensemble de notre infrastructure (Workday, Data Lake, University, ...) pour faire évoluer nos interfaces d'une logique de consultation vers une logique d'action.

Dans ce cadre, nous développons DaiLY, notre agent conversationnel RH. Il aide nos collaborateurs et managers à accéder instantanément à une information fiable, sourcée à partir de notre documentation Workday et de nos politiques People.

Déjà déployé avec succès en France, DaiLY entre dans une nouvelle phase de passage à l'échelle : extension internationale, industrialisation des évaluations, amélioration continue de nos modèles et de leurs qualités et déploiement et intégration d’agents autonomes RH. 

 

Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e développeur.se, nous avons besoin d'un.e "Builder" : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin métier en solution technique, de l’implémenter, la qualifier, la déployer et la maintenir dans le temps.

 

 🎯 VOTRE MISSION

Nous recherchons un(e) AI Engineer confirmé(e) pour participer activement à l'industrialisation et au développement de DaiLY. Votre objectif est clair : transformer les besoins métiers RH en fonctionnalités IA fiables, mesurables et robustes.

Pour relever ce défi, vous évoluerez au sein d'un collectif dédié, en collaboration directe avec d'autres AI Engineers, un Lead AI Engineer (qui orientera les choix d'architecture globale) et une Product Manager. Cette organisation de proximité vous permettra d'assurer une synergie parfaite entre les enjeux produits, la roadmap et l'implémentation technique.

Vous aurez notamment un rôle clé dans l'évolution de DaiLY : passer d'un modèle de simple consultation (Q&A) à un véritable système agentique transactionnel capable de déclencher des actions concrètes (ex : poser des congés dans Workday, s'inscrire à des formations via Decathlon University).

 

🛠 VOS RESPONSABILITES 

  1. Développement Agentique & Fonctionnalités
  • Participer à l'extension des capacités de DaiLY vers des actions d'écriture (write actions) en implémentant des protocoles de tool-calling (MCP - Model Context Protocol) et des communications inter-agents (A2A).
  • Implémenter des stratégies avancées de chunking et de re-ranking pour prioriser les règles spécifiques au domaine RH.
  • Contribuer à l'optimisation des coûts, de la latence et de l'efficacité globale du système en lien avec les équipes Plateforme et Infrastructure.
  1. Qualité, Évaluation & Observabilité (LLMOps)
  • Développer et maintenir la couche de qualité du pipeline RAG multi-agents (Vertex AI Search / Discovery Engine).
  • Assurer le grounding (ancrage) des réponses et la vérification des citations pour garantir la traçabilité vers une source de vérité.
  • Mettre en place des pipelines d'observabilité robustes pour l'évaluation online et offline (OpenTelemetry, MLflow).
  • Coder des évaluateurs automatiques basés sur des golden datasets pour itérer sereinement et prévenir les régressions avant chaque mise en production.
  • Intégrer des garde-fous (guardrails) pour protéger le système et les utilisateurs contre les hallucinations et les erreurs.
  1. Sécurité, Cloisonnement & Déploiement International
  • Access Management (ACLs) : Implémenter une gestion granulaire et dynamique des droits d'accès au niveau de l'indexation et du retrieval, garantissant qu'un collaborateur n'accède strictement qu'aux documents RH de son périmètre.
  • Isolation & Multi-tenancy : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies de filtrage par métadonnées (metadata filtering) en base vectorielle et de cloisonnement (des index et/ou des modèles) pour assurer une étanchéité parfaite des données entre les différentes sociétés fiscales, entités légales et géographies de Decathlon.
  • Support Multilingue : Contribuer à l'architecture d'internationalisation de DaiLY en adaptant les pipelines RAG, l'embedding et l'inférence pour maintenir un haut niveau de performance et de pertinence sur une grande diversité de langues.
  1. Produit & Impact Business
  • Aider à l'analyse des intentions des utilisateurs pour mesurer l'impact de DaiLY.
  • Traduire, avec l'appui de la Product Manager et du Lead, les enjeux métier en comportements de modèles et en métriques de succès.

🧠 PROFIL RECHERCHE

Nous recherchons un profil justifiant a minima d’une première expérience. 

  • Expérience : Profil confirmé justifiant de plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle en entreprise (hors stages et alternances) en AI Engineering, ML Engineering ou Software Engineering orienté IA. Vous justifiez également d'au moins une expérience concrète et réussie de mise en production d'un système GenAI ou agentique.
  • Stack Technique : Solide maîtrise de Python, de l'écosystème GCP / Vertex AI, et des frameworks d'orchestration (LangChain, LlamaIndex ou ADK).
  • Expertise LLM & Agentique : Solide maîtrise des architectures RAG (recherche vectorielle, Vertex AI Vector Search, gestion avancée de métadonnées), mais surtout des concepts techniques agentiques : function/tool-calling, boucles de raisonnement (ReAct, etc.), orchestration de workflows multi-agents, structured output et gestion du contexte/mémoire.
  • Qualité & Évaluation : Capacité à diagnostiquer une réponse incorrecte (problème de modèle, de retrieval ou de données) et appétence pour l'observabilité applicative (SQL / BigQuery / MLflow).
  • Langues : Anglais professionnel courant (environnement international).

Les plus : 

  • Connaissance technique approfondie des protocoles A2A (Agent-to-Agent) et MCP.
  • Expérience de traitement multimodal de documents ou dans des écosystèmes SIRH (ex: Workday).
  • Compréhension technique des enjeux de sécurité (RBAC, ACLs, RGPD) appliqués aux LLMs.
  • Connaissance des architectures microservices et conception d'APIs.

 

🎁 CE QUE NOUS PROPOSONS

  • L'opportunité de développer un produit d'IA agentique de pointe avec un impact direct sur le quotidien de 100 000 collaborateurs.
  • Un environnement technologique premium (Stack Google Cloud / Vertex AI / Databricks).
  • Une politique de télétravail flexible (2 jours par semaine en remote, le reste dans nos bureaux à Paris - Canal de l’Ourcq).
  • Une culture du delivery axée sur l'autonomie, l'intelligence collective et la montée en compétences (accompagnement par un Lead, certifications, formations).

  • Une ambiance résolument tournée vers le sport (nombreuses corpos, tests produits, pauses déjeuner sportives ou non, …)

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel: 
Job ID: 1893 

ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking & financial institutions from the “harvest-now, decrypt-later” threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.

The Role: 

We are looking for a Staff Cryptography Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will implement the software side of modern post-quantum algorithms: reference models, optimised implementations, and the test infrastructure that proves they are correct. This is a hands-on development role at the heart of applied cryptography, working with some of the most experienced cryptographic engineers in the field.

Responsibilities:

You will implement and maintain reference and bit-accurate models of ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS in C/C++/Rust and Python, develop constant-time software implementations of cryptographic functions, and build out the known-answer-test and test-vector tooling (NIST ACVP) used for verification and CAVP certification. You will contribute to the decomposition of algorithms into hardware-friendly building blocks (Keccak, NTT and polynomial arithmetic, samplers, encode/decode), support RTL and firmware engineers with algorithm questions and debugging, and help evaluate third-party cryptographic libraries, working under the guidance of our senior cryptography engineers.

  • Implement reference models, optimised software and test-vector infrastructure for ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS
  • Support hardware and firmware teams with algorithm expertise, debugging and certification-oriented tooling

Requirements:

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s degree (PhD a plus) in Cryptography, Mathematics, Computer Science or a related field and at least five years of experience implementing cryptographic algorithms or security-critical software in C/C++ or Rust. You have solid understanding of modern cryptographic primitives and ideally first exposure to post-quantum schemes (lattice-based or hash-based) and their underlying mathematics.

The role demands fluency on both sides of the transition: deep classical mastery combined with a solid working command of the post-quantum algorithms and standards the products are built around.

Responsibilities:

You will own the architecture and implementation strategy of the classical cryptographic functions of the product line: symmetric ciphers and modes (AES/GCM and beyond), hash functions (SHA-2/SHA-3, HMAC/KDF constructions), RSA/ECC offload, and true random number generation and entropy architecture (SP 800-90A/B/C). You will define the hybrid classical/post-quantum schemes (key establishment, dual signatures, composite certificates) and the crypto-agility mechanisms that allow customers to migrate safely, track the standardisation of hybrid and composite approaches (NIST guidance, IETF work on hybrid key establishment in TLS 1.3 and IKEv2, composite certificates) together with our PQC architects, guide RTL and software engineers implementing classical cores, technically evaluate third-party IP, and support FIPS 140-3 and CAVP certification of the classical algorithm suite. You will also own key-management and key-hierarchy architecture across the product, ensuring interoperability with deployed HSM, TLS and IPsec ecosystems.

Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

title: Robotics Software Engineer - Grasping
description:
Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core.

Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics.

Role

As a Robotics Software Engineer, you will develop and implement robust algorithms to facilitate complex robotic operations in real-world manufacturing environments. Our team is responsible for both motion planning and grasping, with this role dedicated specifically to advancing our grasping capabilities. To succeed, you will bring a strong foundation in robotics—whether from a background in motion planning, control systems, or manipulation—to write excellent, production-quality code. You will help abstract the inherent complexity of robotic tasks into intuitive, seamless workflows, enabling users to transition from design to execution without needing deep subject matter expertise. Working alongside a diverse team of roboticists and application engineers, you will integrate and validate solutions across various industrial tasks and contribute to the launch of impactful robotics products.

How your work moves the mission forward

  • Algorithm Development: Design, implement, and maintain efficient, production-ready algorithms for robotic grasping.
  • Problem Solving: Collaborate with the team to apply cutting-edge advancements in robotics to practical, real-world industrial problems.
  • Technical Execution: Transform complex partner requirements into highly reliable, functional, and scalable technical outcomes.
  • System Reliability: Improve our core robotics software framework, ensuring high code quality and contributing to a highly reliable product.

Skills you will need to be successful

  • Master’s degree in Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of professional experience in robotics (backgrounds in motion planning, control, or grasping/manipulation are all welcome).
  • Software Engineering: Exceptional programming skills in C++ and Python, with a proven track record of writing clean, efficient, and production-quality software.
  • Robotics Fundamentals: Strong foundation in linear algebra, spatial transformations, kinematics, and rigid body dynamics.
  • Hardware Experience: Direct experience testing, deploying, and iterating on physical robot hardware.

Skills that will differentiate your candidacy

  • PhD in Robotics or a related field with a specific focus on motion planning, controls, or grasping.
  • Prior exposure to or interest in robotic grasping and manipulation projects.
  • Full-Stack Robotics: Experience developing across the entire robotics stack, ranging from writing kinematics and motion generation to system integration and testing.

// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world.
