title: Senior Full Stack Product Engineer (TypeScript)
description: About Maze Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development. In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in. We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision. Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves. That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey —and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more. Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values . Location: Remote , preference for Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Spain or Portugal. Key engineering and product teams are based in these locales. The Role As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer on the Product Engineering team, you'll design and deliver high impact features, working closely with product, design, and other engineers to solve complex problems, build scalable solutions, and ensure our systems are maintainable and performant. You’ll take ownership of projects from concept to production, contribute to architectural decisions, write high quality code, and help raise the technical bar by sharing knowledge and best practices with your teammates. You'll work on: Building elegant features for user researchers to analyze and extract compelling insights from qualitative data, using both classical techniques and large language models Expanding audience management to help researchers connect with and reward participants from across the world Integrating video and scheduling tools to provide a streamlined experience for managing and booking user interviews As a product engineer at Maze, you will: Partner closely with product managers, designers and other engineers to design, build, and ship new features Establish best practices, frameworks, and repeatable processes that enable us to measure the impact of every feature that we ship Evaluate and improve the performance, maintainability, and security of applications in production Work in a collaborative and open team, which places high value on feedback, continuous learning and trust. You should apply if: You're proficient with modern full-stack JavaScript (Node.js and React) and relational databases (PostgreSQL) You're enthusiastic about well-tested code and strive to improve your work environment You have excellent written and spoken English skills You thrive in a remote environment Bonus points: You have Next.js, NestJS, GraphQL, and/or TypeScript experience You have experience with AWS and/or Kubernetes You're interested in UX, UI design, and the research field Inclusivity and Pay At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture. Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package. Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations. Why Maze is unique Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze. Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge. Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions Benefits Health insurance with international coverage, vision, and dental: 100% of the team member premium paid For some locations, coverage options vary, please see our benefits pages for more information Free access to proper mental health care, unlimited virtual therapy sessions (with a human) and 24/7 access to resources Life and Disability Insurance, 100% of the team member premium paid Flexible time off Meaningful equity Company retreats, fully paid for by Maze New MacBook (laptop), paid for by Maze Paid Family leave: 16 weeks for birth or adoptive parents $500/month to be used for dependent health insurance coverage If you don't have dependents to add to your plan, you will still get access to this money to be used at your discretion to get the benefits that matter to you with our flexible a-maze-ing benefits - gym memberships, co-working spaces, food, travel, whatever! $1,500 remote work setup fund to ensure you can set up a productive work space Flexible work schedule where you manage your own working hours Monthly Bonus.ly points that are awarded to others to recognize teamwork, dedication and helpfulness - points can be cashed out for gift cards and more Virtual social engagements randomly throughout the year SWAG, we have some really cool swag Open, transparent culture that includes virtual: coffee chats, bi-weekly all-hands meetings, and more Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here . Outreach Notice We understand you might be excited about the job you’re applying for, we are excited you are interested! However, please refrain from reaching out to our current team members on LinkedIn for referrals. Our policy is that referrals can only be provided by team members who personally know the candidate. With the high volume of interest in our roles, contacting our team members who are not involved in recruitment can be overwhelming. Additionally, please avoid submitting support tickets regarding your application , as our support team is not involved in the hiring process. Rest assured, our recruitment team is diligently reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if there is a match.

Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here.

description: About Us The financial advisory industry is a $80T market in the US, but has seen little technological innovation compared to the self-service market (Robinhood, Betterment, Wealthfront, SoFi). Client data management is a universally painful and expensive problem for financial advisors. Today, advisors manually collect, update, and utilize client data across the 7-10 software tools that they use to run their business. Data transcription and translation across systems is time-consuming and error-prone, leading to costly inefficiencies and embarrassing client-facing problems. Managing data access control, audit logs, and compliance is a constant challenge, particularly in larger organizations. We are building the first wealth tech data orchestration company. We sync client data across a financial advisor's tech stack, unlocking the efficiency of a fully-integrated software suite with the choice of tools that best fit their business. We are laser-focused on enabling the best technology experiences for advisors and unlocking the potential of the entire wealth tech software ecosystem. We’re an experienced team of start-up operators with deep roots in both tech and advisory. You can learn more about us on our website . Role Details Role overview: We're looking for a backend engineer to help build and scale our integration infrastructure. You'll work closely with our staff backend engineer to tackle complex problems in data mapping, syncing, and platform reliability while expanding our integration capabilities across the wealth tech ecosystem. Where you'll make an impact: Build and maintain integrations with third-party financial systems, expanding our platform's connectivity across the wealth tech landscape. Solve complex data mapping and synchronization challenges, ensuring accurate and reliable data flow between disparate systems with different schemas and constraints. Develop platform capabilities that enable seamless, scalable data orchestration for our customers' tech stacks. Own end-to-end delivery of backend features and services, from design through deployment and monitoring. Contribute to our integration infrastructure, building reusable patterns and tooling that make adding new integrations faster and more reliable. Collaborate with frontend, product, and design teams to deliver high-quality customer experiences backed by robust backend systems. Requirements: 4-6 years of backend engineering experience with a track record of shipping reliable, well-tested systems. Strong fundamentals in backend development, including API design, data modeling, concurrent systems, and performance optimization. Experience working with relational databases and distributed systems concepts. Curious and eager to learn - you're excited to dig into unfamiliar systems, understand complex integrations, and grow your technical skills. Bias toward action and ownership - you see a problem, propose solutions, and drive it to completion without needing constant direction. Strong communication skills and comfort working cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineers. Thrive in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities and high autonomy. Interest and experience with AI tools and prompting - you leverage AI in your workflow and can help level up the team's capabilities. We move fast, iterate quickly, and have a high bar for what “excellent” looks like. We sync client data across a financial advisor's tech stack, unlocking the efficiency of a fully-integrated software suite with the choice of tools that best fit their business. We are laser-focused on enabling the best technology experiences for advisors and unlocking the potential of the entire wealth tech software ecosystem. We’re an experienced team of start-up operators with deep roots in both tech and advisory. You can learn more about us on our website.

Role Details

Role overview:

We're looking for a backend engineer to help build and scale our integration infrastructure. You'll work closely with our staff backend engineer to tackle complex problems in data mapping, syncing, and platform reliability while expanding our integration capabilities across the wealth tech ecosystem.

Where you'll make an impact:

  • Build and maintain integrations with third-party financial systems, expanding our platform's connectivity across the wealth tech landscape.

  • Solve complex data mapping and synchronization challenges, ensuring accurate and reliable data flow between disparate systems with different schemas and constraints.

  • Develop platform capabilities that enable seamless, scalable data orchestration for our customers' tech stacks.

  • Own end-to-end delivery of backend features and services, from design through deployment and monitoring.

  • Contribute to our integration infrastructure, building reusable patterns and tooling that make adding new integrations faster and more reliable.

  • Collaborate with frontend, product, and design teams to deliver high-quality customer experiences backed by robust backend systems.

Requirements:

  • 4-6 years of backend engineering experience with a track record of shipping reliable, well-tested systems.

  • Strong fundamentals in backend development, including API design, data modeling, concurrent systems, and performance optimization.

  • Experience working with relational databases and distributed systems concepts.

  • Curious and eager to learn - you're excited to dig into unfamiliar systems, understand complex integrations, and grow your technical skills.

  • Previously built side projects or contributed to open source software.

Our tech stack: Golang, Redis, PostgreSQL, AWS SQS, Amazon S3

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

As an Applied Research Engineer in our Video team, you will help build the next generation of production-grade foundation models for human-centric video generation.

You will join a highly focused team working at the intersection of large-scale generative modeling, distributed systems, and production engineering. Our mission is to develop and optimize video base models that power realistic, controllable, and emotionally expressive synthetic humans at scale.

This is not pure research. This is applied research with direct product impact.

You will work on advancing training recipes, scaling distributed systems, improving evaluation frameworks, and optimizing inference to ensure our models are high quality, stable, and efficient enough for real-world deployment. Your work will directly influence models used by tens of thousands of businesses worldwide.
What you’ll do

You will own and execute end-to-end research and engineering projects, from hypothesis to production impact. This includes:

  • Developing and scaling latent video diffusion models tailored for human-centric video generation

  • Designing conditioning mechanisms to improve control (pose, emotion, script, camera) without sacrificing fidelity

  • Advancing distributed training strategies (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed, sequence parallelism) under real compute constraints

  • Improving training stability at multi-node scale

  • Designing rigorous evaluation frameworks combining automated metrics and structured human evaluation

  • Optimizing inference for low latency, high resolution, and cost efficiency

  • Running controlled ablations and experiments to drive high-signal modeling decisions

  • Contributing to high engineering standards: reproducibility, experiment tracking, CI/CD, monitoring

You will be expected to move fast, run multiple hypotheses in parallel, identify signal early, and focus on outcomes rather than exploration for its own sake.
What we’re looking for


Must-have

  • Strong experience training deep learning models at scale

  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills

  • Hands-on experience with diffusion models (image domain required; video preferred)

  • Experience with large scale multi-GPU / multi-node training

  • Good understanding of distributed training (DDP, FSDP, DeepSpeed or similar)

  • Ability to design controlled experiments and interpret noisy results

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with video diffusion models

  • Experience in avatar or human-centric generation

  • Familiarity with world / interactive models

  • Experience with GANs or VAEs

Experience optimizing inference systems for production

Our stack

  • Python, PyTorch, CUDA

  • DeepSpeed, distributed training & inference

  • Sequence parallelism

  • AWS, SLURM, Docker

  • GitHub, CI/CD pipelines

Who you are

  • You are research-driven but outcome-focused

  • You care about shipping, not just publishing

  • You can explore multiple ideas quickly and drop low-signal directions early

  • You communicate clearly and present results scientifically

  • You operate independently but collaborate actively across teams

Why join us?

  • Build production-scale video foundation models in a fast-growing Generative AI company

  • Work on human-centric video generation with real-world impact

  • Tackle hard problems in scaling, stability, and controllability

  • Influence the direction of next-generation synthetic human technology

  • Join a highly technical, high-ownership environment where your work ships

If you want to work on cutting-edge generative video models and see your research power real-world products, we’d love to talk.
Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

 

Serving 50,000+ customers (and 50% of the Fortune 500)

We’re trusted by leading brands such as Heineken, Zoom, Xerox, McDonald’s and more. Read stories from happy customers and what 1,200+ people say on G2.

 

Proprietary AI technology

Since 2017, we’ve been pioneering advancements in Generative AI. Our AI technology is built in-house, by a team of world-class AI researchers and engineers. Learn more about our AI Research Lab and the team behind.

 

AI Safety, Ethics and Security

AI safety, ethics, and security are fundamental to our mission. While the full scope of Artificial Intelligence's impact on our society is still unfolding, our position is clear: People first. Always. Learn more about our commitments to AI Ethics, Safety & Security.

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management
  • Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes
  • Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements
  • Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff
  • Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA
  • Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities
  • Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights
  • Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise
  • Interact directly with customers as needed
  • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others
  • Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs
  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation
  • 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment
  • Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements
  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis
  • Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights
  • Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers
  • Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items
  • Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines
  • Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

title: Software Architect
description: Job Requisition ID # 26WD94957 Position Overview At Autodesk , we are pioneers in 3D design, engineering, and entertainment software, building tools that empower some of the most creative minds on the planet to solve real-world problems. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Glassdoor, and others as a top place to work, we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where innovation and creativity thrive. Autodesk's Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) Data organization is seeking an experienced Software Architect to join the AEC Data team and define the cloud-native services and distributed-systems architecture that power the AEC Data Model (AECDM) and the many services around it. Data is the domain, but the role is fundamentally one of cloud and services architecture — APIs, service contracts, integrations, distributed-systems design, and the connected data model that ties them together — spanning multiple teams. It is not a data-warehouse or analytics-specialist role. The AEC Data organization is building the foundational data infrastructure behind Autodesk's vision for connected construction: the platforms, services, and unified data models that span the entire built-asset lifecycle, from design and construction through operation and maintenance. This work enables the continuous flow of AEC data (3D models, 2D drawings, issue tracking, cost, sensor streams, and more) across Autodesk products and third-party integrations. The architect will help shape the next generation of capabilities for the Autodesk Forma Industry Cloud, collaborating with software architects, domain experts, and product teams across Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD, Autodesk Construction Cloud, and Autodesk Forma. This is a senior individual-contributor role on an established architecture track, reporting to the Distinguished Architect of the AEC Data team, who also serves as the Lead Software Architect. The primary responsibility is to shape how multiple teams design and build — through standards, reference architectures, ADRs, and design-review governance — rather than to own a single service. The exact focus flexes to your strengths and organizational need. Responsibilities API Design & Evolution : Design and evolve API surfaces across the AEC Data services — resource modeling, addressing, versioning and backward-compatible evolution, query APIs, and unifying overlapping surfaces into a single coherent contract. System Architecture : Define and evolve cross-team, cloud-native architecture across the AEC Data services; design distributed systems including service contracts and event-driven flows. Schema Design & Evolution : Design, document, and evolve data schemas for AEC domain entities (buildings, infrastructure, spaces, systems, components, relationships) — including semantic models, property sets, classification systems, and relationship hierarchies. Own versioning, backward/forward compatibility, deprecation, and migration; maintain the schema registry, validation rules, and quality checks. Standards & Governance : Establish standards, reference architectures, and reusable components; author architecture proposals and decision records (ADRs) for review by a cross-org architecture council, and run cross-team design reviews. Prototyping & Feasibility : Evaluate alternative architectural directions through modeling and prototyping, de-risking key decisions before broad adoption. Mentorship & Technical Leadership : Mentor engineers and fellow architects on emerging and established technologies and on architectural practice; grow technical depth across teams. Reliability & Performance : Ensure reliability, security, and performance of systems; define SLOs and drive observability (metrics, tracing, logging). Communication : Communicate architecture with clear views and diagrams (e.g., C4) and executive-ready narratives; produce comprehensive documentation and onboarding materials. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent experience. 10+ years designing cloud-native, distributed systems, including 5+ years at cross-team architect altitude (Software Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff+, or equivalent). Title is flexible; scope of impact is the primary consideration. Deep expertise in cloud services (ideally AWS), API/service design, and distributed-systems patterns (microservices, event-driven, resilience). Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design — including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies — as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required. Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns. Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management. Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams. Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders. Ability to collaborate with a global team. Preferred Qualifications Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. Core: Cloud Services : AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS). Distributed Systems : Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design. API & Service Design : REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation). Database Architecture : Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL). Observability/SRE : OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services. Bonus: Semantic Technologies : Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs — particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM. BIM Expertise : Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems. AI Systems : RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering). Domain-Specific AI for AEC : BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing. Event-Driven Architectures : Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing. AEC Domain Knowledge : Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided. About the Team The AEC Data team is building the AEC Data Model (AECDM) to enable better AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Operations) outcomes through more useful, connected, and accessible data. Its scope spans data services and APIs, product and design-tool integrations, and lifecycle/asset data across multiple teams — enabling the seamless flow of information across Autodesk products and third-party integrations so that AEC professionals can make better decisions with better data. Why Join Us Shape the future of AEC data platforms and standards at an industry-leading company. Design systems and schemas used by millions of architects, engineers, and construction professionals worldwide. Collaborate with world-class software architects and engineers across Autodesk's AEC portfolio. Contribute to open standards and interoperability initiatives that benefit the entire industry. Join a team that values technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning. Learn More About Autodesk Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made. We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world. When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us! Salary transparency Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package. Belonging We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging Are you an existing contractor or consultant with Autodesk? Please search for open jobs and apply internally (not on this external site).

  • Solid grounding in data modeling and schema design — including schema definition languages (e.g., JSON Schema), versioning, and backward/forward-compatibility and evolution strategies — as applied both to standalone data schemas and to API contracts. Specialist data-warehouse or analytics architecture is not required. 

  • Excellent knowledge of software design and architecture patterns. 

  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across teams outside the candidate's direct management. 

  • Strong leadership and mentoring skills, with a track record of guiding and growing diverse, cross-functional teams. 

  • Mastery of conveying complex ideas concisely and persuasively, with excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills across a range of stakeholders. 

  • Ability to collaborate with a global team. 

Preferred Qualifications 

Preferred qualifications are a menu rather than a checklist: depth in a few core areas matters more than breadth across all of them. The emerging AI/ML capabilities below are advantageous and can be developed on the job; they are not prerequisites. 

Core: 

  • Cloud Services: AWS and its core services (EC2, ECS, Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, RDS). 

  • Distributed Systems: Domain-driven service decomposition, data consistency patterns (CQRS, event sourcing, sagas), and multi-tenant/multi-region design. 

  • API & Service Design: REST API design and evolution; GraphQL (including federation). 

  • Database Architecture: Relational and NoSQL (e.g., DynamoDB, PostgreSQL). 

  • Observability/SRE: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, metrics/SLOs for data services. 

Bonus: 

  • Semantic Technologies: Knowledge graphs, RDF/OWL, or property graphs — particularly relevant to the connected/semantic AECDM. 

  • BIM Expertise: Building Information Modeling concepts, Revit families, or similar parametric modeling systems. 

  • AI Systems: RAG, agents/MCP, agentic orchestration (LangGraph, Semantic Kernel), LLM observability, and data governance / AI safety (PII, prompt-injection, content filtering). 

  • Domain-Specific AI for AEC: BIM/IFC extraction, CAD or point-cloud processing. 

  • Event-Driven Architectures: Kafka or Kinesis; schema registries (Confluent, AWS Glue); exactly-once processing. 

  • AEC Domain Knowledge: Experience in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction industry; familiarity with industry standards (IFC, COBie, gbXML, CityGML, LandXML, UniFormat, OmniClass). Domain onboarding is provided. 

About the Team 

The AEC Data team is building the AEC Data Model (AECDM) to enable better AECO (Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Operations) outcomes through more useful, connected, and accessible data. Its scope spans data services and APIs, product and design-tool integrations, and lifecycle/asset data across multiple teams — enabling the seamless flow of information across Autodesk products and third-party integrations so that AEC professionals can make better decisions with better data. 

Why Join Us 

  • Shape the future of AEC data platforms and standards at an industry-leading company. 

  • Design systems and schemas used by millions of architects, engineers, and construction professionals worldwide. 

  • Collaborate with world-class software architects and engineers across Autodesk's AEC portfolio. 

  • Contribute to open standards and interoperability initiatives that benefit the entire industry. 

  • Join a team that values technical excellence, innovation, and continuous learning.

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

title: Senior Reviewer - Code & Web Templates
description: About Us At Envato , we empower creative pros to thrive. We're here to help creatives bring their ideas to life, supercharge their workflows, and equip them with an unparalleled toolkit they can use anywhere. With unlimited access to world-class assets, innovative AI tools, and hands-on tutorials, we deliver what creatives need today - and are continually evolving our offering. As AI transforms the creative landscape, we’re committed to building what’s next for the future. We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow. You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024. About the role The Senior Reviewer, Code & Web Templates is responsible for reviewing, assessing, and maintaining quality standards across Envato’s broad code and web template categories, including Web Themes & UI Templates, Template Kits, WordPress, WordPress Plugins, Scripts, Plugins, and Code assets. As Envato continues to evolve its Content Operations model, this role will help consolidate review expertise into a smaller, stronger, and more scalable team in Mexico. The Senior Reviewer will be expected to apply expert judgment across the full Code Review landscape, ensuring that submissions meet Envato’s technical, usability, security, originality, documentation, and commercial-quality expectations. This role plays a critical part in protecting customer trust, supporting contributor quality, improving review consistency, and helping Envato maintain a high-quality marketplace experience across its web, theme, template, and code categories. What you'll be doing Scope of Review Coverage This role may review and support quality decisions across the following asset groups: - Web Themes & UI Templates. - Site Templates. - UI Templates. - Template Kits. - ThemeForest categories, excluding areas that require separate specialists. handling where applicable. - WordPress themes. - WordPress plugins. - Scripts. - Plugins. - Code assets. - Front-end templates and components. - Admin dashboards, landing pages, HTML templates, and related web products. - PHP, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and CMS-based assets. Deep specialization in every domain is not required from the outset. However, this role requires a strong full-stack technical foundation, practical hands-on experience, and the learning agility necessary to effectively review, assess, and contribute across all relevant areas at a high professional standard. Content Review & Quality Assessment Review and assess submissions across all code and web template categories against Envato’s technical, quality, usability, documentation, security, and commercial standards. Apply review criteria consistently across all asset types, including design quality, code quality, functionality, responsiveness, browser compatibility, accessibility, performance, security, dependency management, documentation, installation and setup experience, originality, and commercial value, while adapting standards to the specific expectations of each category. Identify and reject submissions that do not meet marketplace standards, including those with poor code quality, broken functionality, inadequate documentation, security concerns, excessive dependencies, low originality, poor usability, intellectual property risks, or limited commercial value. Provide clear, objective, and constructive review outcomes aligned with established review guidelines. Risk Management & Escalation Identify complex, ambiguous, or high-risk submissions and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders for further review. Recognize emerging category risks, contributor patterns, and quality concerns that may impact marketplace standards or customer trust. Standards, Documentation & Continuous Improvement Support calibration activities to ensure consistency and alignment of review standards across the Code Review team. Contribute to the development and maintenance of review documentation, category standards, technical benchmarks, and reviewer enablement materials. Identify recurring contributor issues, operational bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve review quality, efficiency, and consistency. raw.jobDescription:
About Us

At Envato, we empower creative pros to thrive.

We're here to help creatives bring their ideas to life, supercharge their workflows, and equip them with an unparalleled toolkit they can use anywhere. With unlimited access to world-class assets, innovative AI tools, and hands-on tutorials, we deliver what creatives need today - and are continually evolving our offering. As AI transforms the creative landscape, we’re committed to building what’s next for the future.

We’re a purpose-driven company and we’ve long embraced flexible, inclusive ways of working. We’re proud of the connected culture we’ve built across our global team. Our values: Customer First, Build our Future, Make it Happen and Embrace Diversity guide everything we do, shaping how we work and grow.

You can read more about us on our blog, including news of our acquisition by Shutterstock Inc in 2024.

About the role

The Senior Reviewer, Code & Web Templates is responsible for reviewing, assessing, and maintaining quality standards across Envato’s broad code and web template categories, including Web Themes & UI Templates, Template Kits, WordPress, WordPress Plugins, Scripts, Plugins, and Code assets.

As Envato continues to evolve its Content Operations model, this role will help consolidate review expertise into a smaller, stronger, and more scalable team in Mexico. The Senior Reviewer will be expected to apply expert judgment across the full Code Review landscape, ensuring that submissions meet Envato’s technical, usability, security, originality, documentation, and commercial-quality expectations.

This role plays a critical part in protecting customer trust, supporting contributor quality, improving review consistency, and helping Envato maintain a high-quality marketplace experience across its web, theme, template, and code categories.

What you'll be doing

Scope of Review Coverage

  • This role may review and support quality decisions across the following asset groups:
    - Web Themes & UI Templates.
    - Site Templates.
    - UI Templates.
    - Template Kits.
    - ThemeForest categories, excluding areas that require separate specialists. handling where applicable.
    - WordPress themes.
    - WordPress plugins.
    - Scripts.
    - Plugins.
    - Code assets.
    - Front-end templates and components.
    - Admin dashboards, landing pages, HTML templates, and related web products.
    - PHP, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and CMS-based assets.
  • Deep specialization in every domain is not required from the outset. However, this role requires a strong full-stack technical foundation, practical hands-on experience, and the learning agility necessary to effectively review, assess, and contribute across all relevant areas at a high professional standard.

Content Review & Quality Assessment

  • Review and assess submissions across all code and web template categories against Envato’s technical, quality, usability, documentation, security, and commercial standards.
  • Apply review criteria consistently across all asset types, including design quality, code quality, functionality, responsiveness, browser compatibility, accessibility, performance, security, dependency management, documentation, installation and setup experience, originality, and commercial value, while adapting standards to the specific expectations of each category.
  • Identify and reject submissions that do not meet marketplace standards, including those with poor code quality, broken functionality, inadequate documentation, security concerns, excessive dependencies, low originality, poor usability, intellectual property risks, or limited commercial value.
  • Provide clear, objective, and constructive review outcomes aligned with established review guidelines.

Risk Management & Escalation

  • Identify complex, ambiguous, or high-risk submissions and escalate them to the appropriate stakeholders for further review.
  • Recognize emerging category risks, contributor patterns, and quality concerns that may impact marketplace standards or customer trust.

Standards, Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Support calibration activities to ensure consistency and alignment of review standards across the Code Review team.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of review documentation, category standards, technical benchmarks, and reviewer enablement materials.
  • Identify recurring contributor issues, operational bottlenecks, and opportunities to improve review quality, efficiency, and consistency.
  • Stay current with modern web development practices, WordPress, JavaScript frameworks, UI/UX trends, plugin ecosystems, marketplace expectations, and AI-assisted development trends.

Team Collaboration & Operational Support

  • Partner with Content Operations leaders to support the evolution of the review function, including the transition from a larger contractor model to a smaller, highly skilled, cross-functional Mexico-based review team.
  • Maintain productivity and turnaround expectations while ensuring quality, consistency, and customer trust are not compromised.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in code and web template review, supporting team knowledge sharing, reviewer development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

About you

Key Capabilities

  • Strong full-stack development background with practical experience across front-end and back-end web development, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, WordPress themes and plugins, scripts, and web templates - covering responsive design, browser compatibility, performance optimization, and accessibility basics.
  • Strong understanding of WordPress ecosystems including template hierarchy, installation workflows, customization, dependencies, and common marketplace quality issues.
  • Strong understanding of clean code practices, file organization, naming conventions, documentation standards, version compatibility, and user setup experience.
  • Ability to identify common technical risks including broken functionality, poor code structure, weak security practices, performance issues, unsupported dependencies, and poor customer usability.
  • Strong eye for commercial quality, customer value, modern design execution, and marketplace relevance.
  • Ability to use AI-assisted tools to support review throughput, code analysis, and other workflow and productivity efficiencies.
  • Ability to make consistent, objective, and well-reasoned review decisions across multiple asset categories.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly and professionally.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to identify technical and quality issues quickly.
  • Comfortable maintaining strong quality standards while meeting productivity and turnaround expectations.
  • Ability to collaborate with global teams in a remote or hybrid environment.
  • Fluent or strong professional proficiency in English.

Required Technical Coverage

This role requires solid working knowledge across several relevant technical domains, with the adaptability and learning agility needed to develop proficiency across the broader review scope over time.

  • HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive web development
  • PHP and WordPress development.
  • WordPress themes and plugin ecosystems.
  • Site Templates and UI Templates.
  • Template Kits and page-builder-based assets.
  • Scripts, plugins, and reusable code products.
  • Installation, configuration, dependency management and documentation review.
  • Code quality, security basics, compatibility, performance, and maintainability.
  • Marketplace asset quality standards and customer usability expectations.

Additional Experience

  • Previous experience reviewing or creating assets for a digital marketplace.
  • Familiarity with Envato’s marketplaces, including ThemeForest and CodeCanyon.
  • Deeper specialisation in one or more areas beyond the required technical coverage.
  • Experience in QA, technical validation, software testing, content review, or marketplace operations.
  • Familiarity with intellectual property, licensing, open-source dependencies, and AI-assisted code generation risks as they apply to marketplace submissions.
  • Experience supporting process improvement, reviewer calibration, documentation, or category quality standards.

Compensation

Additional Information

Life at Envato

• Flexible Working: remote-first with flexibility for you to manage work and life as you need.

• Work from Anywhere: apply to work in another location for up to 3 months per calendar year.

• Conoce Mexico: a unique travel benefit for you to explore and visit new places across Mexico.

• Connection Budget: an annual budget to connect with the team IRL where and when possible.

• Learning Budget - Study leave and an annual budget for you to put towards your learning and development.

• Home Office Allowance: contribution towards your set-up and a monthly allowance to support work from home costs.

• Wellbeing: access to a holistic assistance program that provides support in many areas of life and health.

• Volunteer Leave: 2 days per calendar year to volunteer and give back to the community.

• Parental Leave: 20 weeks paid primary carer leave, and 6 weeks paid secondary carers leave.

• Christmas Bonus, Paid Holidays and Holiday Bonus: we offer 30 days paid in December, you will have 12 days vacation in the first year, and you will earn 100% of holiday bonus.

• Grocery tickets: we offer you a monthly amount of 5% (subject to the legal cap) in food vouchers, which can be used in markets, pharmacies and more.

• 5% Saving Funds (fondo de ahorro).

• Private Health Insurance (SGMM).

• Unlimited Ebooks.

title: ChatGPT Performance Engineer
description: About the Team We bring OpenAI 's technology to the world through products like ChatGPT and the OpenAI API. We seek to learn from deployment and distribute the benefits of AI, while ensuring that this powerful tool is used responsibly and safely. Safety is more important to us than unfettered growth. About the Role OpenAI is looking for an experienced Performance Engineer to help us scale the performance, reliability, and efficiency of our systems. In this role, you'll apply deep technical expertise to optimize infrastructure and application-level performance across mission-critical products like ChatGPT and our developer API. You’ll work cross-functionally with teams building core services, training models, and developing real-time user experiences to push our latency, throughput, and cost-efficiency to the next level. We are looking for engineers who thrive in ambiguous environments, value deep systems understanding, and are motivated by delivering measurable impact. This is a highly technical, individual contributor role focused on root-cause analysis, profiling, instrumentation, and architecture-level performance improvements across our stack. In this role, you will: Analyze and optimize performance across application, middleware, runtime, and infrastructure layers—networking, storage, Python runtime, GPU utilization, and beyond. Develop tooling and metrics that provide deep observability into system performance. Collaborate closely with infra, platform, training, and product teams to identify key performance goals and drive systemic improvements. Influence architecture and design decisions to prioritize latency, throughput, and efficiency at scale. Lead investigations into high-impact performance regressions or scalability issues in production. Drive performance testing strategies and help define SLAs/SLOs around latency and throughput for critical systems. You might thrive in this role if you: Have 7+ years of experience in software engineering with a strong track record in performance or reliability of high-scale distributed systems. Are deeply comfortable with performance profiling tools and tracing systems. Have experience optimizing performance across one or more layers of the stack (e.g., database, networking, storage, application runtime, GC tuning, Python/Golang internals, GPU utilization). Have a strong understanding of OS internals, scheduling, memory management, and IO patterns. Have contributed to observability, benchmarking, or performance-focused infrastructure at scale. Have demonstrated success navigating ambiguity and aligning stakeholders around performance goals. Value simplicity, rigor, and collaboration when solving complex systems problems. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement . For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form . No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link . OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

title: Demo Engineer
description: Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization .We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey. We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses. We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey. We're designing the future of autonomous marketing , taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do. And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora. About the Team We're a small, high-impact engineering team embedded inside the Go-To-Market organization. Our job is to make Bloomreach impossible to ignore in a sales cycle by using AI to build demo environments, automate work, and create self-serve tools for presales teams around the world. We move fast, experiment constantly, and build things that end up in front of some of the world's largest retailers and brands. We care about craft, speed, reliability, and whether the field can actually use what we ship. The Role Bloomreach is seeking an AI Demo Engineer who is AI-native by instinct: a flexible software engineer who reaches for AI tools first, learns quickly, and uses technology to solve whatever problem is blocking the field. This is not a traditional engineering role. You are not maintaining production systems or working through a standard product backlog - this is a 0-1 Builder role. You will start with ambiguous presales needs, prototype quickly, test with the field, and turn the best ideas into polished demos, automations, internal tools, and repeatable assets. Our work helps the Go-To-Market team clearly articulate the value of Bloomreach’s platform to prospects and partners. You're building the machinery that lets a world-class presales team show rather than tell; configuring environments, creating agentic workflows, and shipping self-serve tooling that lets solution consultants spin up, customize, and run tailored demos of Bloomreach's full platform without coming back to you every time. Some days that means building a demo experience. Other days it means automating a painful workflow, wiring tools together, creating a self-serve template, or using AI to move from vague idea to working prototype faster than a traditional process would allow. You'll work closely with your team lead (based in the US), so strong async collaboration and ability to connect across time zones with EU and US teams are part of the job. What You’ll Do Build AI-powered demo experiences: Design and ship demos, prototypes, and interactive experiences that make Bloomreach's platform feel tangible and relevant. Automate work using AI: Spot repeatable GTM work and turn it into useful automations, prompt patterns, internal tools, integrations, agents, skills, MCPs, SDK-powered workflows, or whatever else best saves time for the field. Enable SC self-service: Build tools that let Solution Consultants configure, personalize, and run tailored demos without engineering intervention for every request. Prototype fast and productize what works: Take loosely defined ideas, build quickly, test with the field, and decide what should become a durable internal product, accelerator, or demo asset. Bring Loomi and Bloomreach AI to life: Use AI-assisted experiences, personalization, LLM integrations, and smart workflows to help prospects understand Bloomreach's value. Train and enable the field : When you ship something new, you make sure the presales team knows how to use it. You document, demo the demo, and build internal confidence. Keep demos reliable under pressure: Troubleshoot quickly, maintain customer-facing environments, and treat a broken demo in front of a prospect with urgency. Technical Background TypeScript / JavaScript, Python, React, Next.js, Node.js, or similar modern web tooling. Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent AI-assisted development tools; LLM APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic; prompt engineering, workflow orchestration, SDK integrations, agents, MCP, or retrieval systems. Shopify ; Hydrogen (Remix-based), Liquid, Storefront API, Admin API. You do not need deep experience with every tool listed. The stronger signal is that you learn quickly, stay current as the AI landscape changes, and use AI itself to close gaps in your own experience. Strong Advantages Experience building demos, internal tools, workflow automations, AI-assisted products, or SDK-based integrations. Familiarity with LLM APIs, agent orchestration, MCP, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt versioning, context engineering, Bloomreach or similar platforms, or Shopify/ecommerce demo environments. UX intuition: you know which sharp edges a demo needs softened to make it feel clear, credible, and impressive. Experience in presales, solutions engineering, developer advocacy, or another customer-facing technical context. Shopify experience is also a plus. Who You Are You're AI-native. Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar tools are not add-ons for you; they are how you build, learn, debug, prototype, and move faster. You're a fast learner. You enjoy the pace of AI tooling changing every week, experiment with new capabilities, and turn them into practical systems. You can turn vague asks into working demos or tools. A loose brief becomes a prototype, automation, demo, or internal tool. You think in reusable patterns. You do not want to solve the same problem manually five times. You want to package the pattern so the next person can use it without coming back to you. You have product and storytelling instincts. You care not just that the workflow works, but that it helps the field tell a clearer story. Your Success Story will be: Within the first 30-60 days: You have ramped up on Bloomreach's platform story, Loomi AI, the demo ecosystem, and shipped your first AI-assisted prototype. After 60-90 days: At least one AI-powered demo, automation, self-serve workflow, or internal tool is being used by Solution Consultants or Demo Engineering. By 6 months: You have helped create a repeatable AI-assisted demo toolkit. SCs can personalize and run more demos independently, manual work is reduced, and the field trusts the tools you built. Why This Role You'll have a direct, visible impact on revenue. What you build influences growth, enterprise deals, and how some of the world's largest retail brands understand Bloomreach. You'll work at the intersection of AI, software engineering, commerce, and storytelling, with room to use modern AI tools aggressively while staying grounded in what helps the field win. The base salary range for this position is €42,000-€52,000. The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. #LI-SF1 The pay range actually offered will take into account a variety of potential factors considered in compensation, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, geographic location, accomplishments, experience, credentials, internal equity and business needs, and may vary from the range listed above. Base Salary Range €42.000—€52.000 EUR More things you'll like about Bloomreach: Culture: A great deal of freedom and trust. At Bloomreach we don’t clock in and out, and we have neither corporate rules nor long approval processes. This freedom goes hand in hand with responsibility. We are interested in results from day one. We have defined our 5 values and the 10 underlying key behaviors that we strongly believe in. We can only succeed if everyone lives these behaviors day to day. We've embedded them in our processes like recruitment, onboarding, feedback, personal development, performance review and internal communication. We believe in flexible working hours to accommodate your working style. We work virtual-first with several Bloomreach Hubs available across three continents. We organize company events to experience the global spirit of the company and get excited about what's ahead. We encourage and support our employees to engage in volunteering activities - every Bloomreacher can take 5 paid days off to volunteer*. The Bloomreach Glassdoor page elaborates on our stellar 4.7/5 rating. The Bloomreach Comparably page Culture score is even higher at 4.9/5 Personal Development: We have a People Development Program - participating in personal development workshops on various topics run by experts from inside the company. We are continuously developing & updating competency maps for select functions. Our resident communication coach Ivo Večeřa is available to help navigate work-related communications & decision-making challenges.* Our managers are strongly encouraged to participate in the Leader Development Program to develop in the areas we consider essential for any leader. The program includes regular comprehensive feedback, consultations with a coach and follow-up check-ins. Bloomreachers utilize the $1,500 professional education budget on an annual basis to purchase education products (books, courses, certifications, etc.)* Well-being: The Employee Assistance Program -- with counselors -- is available for non-work-related challenges.* Subscription to Calm - sleep and meditation app.* We organize ‘DisConnect’ days where Bloomreachers globally enjoy one additional day off each quarter, allowing us to unwind together and focus on activities away from the screen with our loved ones. We facilitate sports, yoga, and meditation opportunities for each other. Extended parental leave up to 26 calendar weeks for Primary Caregivers.* Compensation: Restricted Stock Units or Stock Options are granted depending on a team member’s role, seniority, and location.* Everyone gets to participate in the company's success through the company performance bonus.* We offer an employee referral bonus of up to $3,000! We reward & celebrate work anniversaries -- Bloomversaries!* (*Subject to employment type. Interns are exempt from marked benefits, usually for the first 6 months.) Excited? Join us and transform the future of commerce experiences! If this position doesn't suit you, but you know someone who might be a great fit, share it - we will be very grateful! Any unsolicited resumes/candidate profiles submitted through our website or to personal email accounts of employees of Bloomreach are considered property of Bloomreach and are not subject to payment of agency fees. #LI-Remote

And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

About the Team

We're a small, high-impact engineering team embedded inside the Go-To-Market organization. Our job is to make Bloomreach impossible to ignore in a sales cycle by using AI to build demo environments, automate work, and create self-serve tools for presales teams around the world.

We move fast, experiment constantly, and build things that end up in front of some of the world's largest retailers and brands. We care about craft, speed, reliability, and whether the field can actually use what we ship.

The Role

Bloomreach is seeking an AI Demo Engineer who is AI-native by instinct: a flexible software engineer who reaches for AI tools first, learns quickly, and uses technology to solve whatever problem is blocking the field.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You are not maintaining production systems or working through a standard product backlog - this is a 0-1 Builder role. You will start with ambiguous presales needs, prototype quickly, test with the field, and turn the best ideas into polished demos, automations, internal tools, and repeatable assets.

Our work helps the Go-To-Market team clearly articulate the value of Bloomreach’s platform to prospects and partners. You're building the machinery that lets a world-class presales team show rather than tell; configuring environments, creating agentic workflows, and shipping self-serve tooling that lets solution consultants spin up, customize, and run tailored demos of Bloomreach's full platform without coming back to you every time.

Some days that means building a demo experience. Other days it means automating a painful workflow, wiring tools together, creating a self-serve template, or using AI to move from vague idea to working prototype faster than a traditional process would allow.

You'll work closely with your team lead (based in the US), so strong async collaboration and ability to connect across time zones with EU and US teams are part of the job.

What You’ll Do

Build AI-powered demo experiences: Design and ship demos, prototypes, and interactive experiences that make Bloomreach's platform feel tangible and relevant.

Automate work using AI: Spot repeatable GTM work and turn it into useful automations, prompt patterns, internal tools, integrations, agents, skills, MCPs, SDK-powered workflows, or whatever else best saves time for the field.

Enable SC self-service: Build tools that let Solution Consultants configure, personalize, and run tailored demos without engineering intervention for every request.

Prototype fast and productize what works: Take loosely defined ideas, build quickly, test with the field, and decide what should become a durable internal product, accelerator, or demo asset.

Bring Loomi and Bloomreach AI to life: Use AI-assisted experiences, personalization, LLM integrations, and smart workflows to help prospects understand Bloomreach's value.

Train and enable the field: When you ship something new, you make sure the presales team knows how to use it. You document, demo the demo, and build internal confidence.

Keep demos reliable under pressure: Troubleshoot quickly, maintain customer-facing environments, and treat a broken demo in front of a prospect with urgency.

Technical Background

  • TypeScript / JavaScript, Python, React, Next.js, Node.js, or similar modern web tooling.
  • Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent AI-assisted development tools; LLM APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic; prompt engineering, workflow orchestration, SDK integrations, agents, MCP, or retrieval systems.
  • Shopify; Hydrogen (Remix-based), Liquid, Storefront API, Admin API.

You do not need deep experience with every tool listed. The stronger signal is that you learn quickly, stay current as the AI landscape changes, and use AI itself to close gaps in your own experience.

Strong Advantages

  • Experience building demos, internal tools, workflow automations, AI-assisted products, or SDK-based integrations.
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs, agent orchestration, MCP, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt versioning, context engineering, Bloomreach or similar platforms, or Shopify/ecommerce demo environments.
  • UX intuition: you know which sharp edges a demo needs softened to make it feel clear, credible, and impressive.
  • Experience in presales, solutions engineering, developer advocacy, or another customer-facing technical context. Shopify experience is also a plus.

Who You Are

  • You're AI-native. Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar tools are not add-ons for you; they are how you build, learn, debug, prototype, and move faster.
  • You're a fast learner. You enjoy the pace of AI tooling changing every week, experiment with new capabilities, and turn them into practical systems.
  • You can turn vague asks into working demos or tools. A loose brief becomes a prototype, automation, demo, or internal tool.
  • You think in reusable patterns. You do not want to solve the same problem manually five times. You want to package the pattern so the next person can use it without coming back to you.
  • You have product and storytelling instincts. You care not just that the workflow works, but that it helps the field tell a clearer story.

Your Success Story will be:

Within the first 30-60 days: You have ramped up on Bloomreach's platform story, Loomi AI, the demo ecosystem, and shipped your first AI-assisted prototype.

After 60-90 days: At least one AI-powered demo, automation, self-serve workflow, or internal tool is being used by Solution Consultants or Demo Engineering.

By 6 months: You have helped create a repeatable AI-assisted demo toolkit. SCs can personalize and run more demos independently, manual work is reduced, and the field trusts the tools you built.

Why This Role

You'll have a direct, visible impact on revenue. What you build influences growth, enterprise deals, and how some of the world's largest retail brands understand Bloomreach.

You'll work at the intersection of AI, software engineering, commerce, and storytelling, with room to use modern AI tools aggressively while staying grounded in what helps the field win.

  • Member Experience: Lead Android implementation for the experiences that connect members with their coaches and help them follow through on their plans. Build polished, accessible interfaces with Jetpack Compose and Future’s design system.

  • Connected Health and Wearables: Guide the systems that connect Future with Wear OS, Health Connect, heart-rate data, sensors, and the Android device lifecycle. Protect member data and design for intermittent connectivity.
  • Reliability and Performance: Own app startup, responsiveness, media playback, foreground services, background work, real-time calls, and data synchronization. Use crash, performance, and release telemetry to find problems before members encounter them.

  • Delivery and Release Quality: Improve Gradle builds, GitHub Actions, Fastlane automation, and Google Play delivery. Help the team ship often without trading away stability.
  • Team Leadership: Lead the Android team through technical planning, project execution, design discussions, pairing, and code review. Keep engineers aligned on priorities, decisions, and delivery risks.
  • AI-Assisted Development: Use coding agents and AI tools to speed up exploration, implementation, testing, and review. Apply engineering judgment to validate their output before it reaches members.

Who You Are:

Experience and Background

  • You have 8+ years of professional Android engineering experience, including ownership of complex consumer applications.

  • You have shipped and supported applications through Google Play.
  • You understand performance, offline state, background execution, media playback, permissions, and device fragmentation.
  • You have strong testing habits across unit, integration, UI, and end-to-end layers.
  • You can debug across UI, networking, persistence, services, devices, and CI.
  • You have led complex projects from planning through launch, partnering with product and design while managing scope, dependencies, risks, and delivery.
  • You have operated at lead scope, regardless of title.
  • You use AI coding tools in your development workflow and know how to verify their output.

Domain Passion

You care about health, fitness, and the role that thoughtful coaching can play in someone’s life.

Working Style

  • You care about interaction quality, accessibility, performance, and the small details members notice.
  • You make architectural decisions based on product needs and operating constraints.
  • You raise concerns early and bring possible solutions.
  • You share context, invite feedback, and help other engineers grow.
  • You take ownership from product discovery through production support.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building Wear OS applications or working with the Wearable Data Layer.
  • Experience with Health Connect, health sensors, or Bluetooth devices.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and other laws and regulations that apply to health products and services.
  • Experience with Media3, CameraX, foreground services, or real-time audio and video.
  • Experience designing offline-capable applications with Room, WorkManager, and background synchronization.
  • Experience with fitness, health, coaching, or other personalized consumer products.
  • Experience evolving a design system across a large Compose application.

Compensation, Benefits & Life at Future:

  • Salary range: $190,000-$230,000 / year + equity. The salary range is set based on multiple considerations including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.
  • Health coverage: All employees have access to comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and disability insurance + tax savings accounts
  • 401(k) plan

  • Future Membership: Enjoy our platform for free!

  • Remote First: Employment eligible to employees located anywhere in the continental US. No travel required.
